 Dream Improvement · Various Blessings ·
 Minchah · Maariv · Shema al HaMittah · Marital Holiness

 
 By Rabbi Nachman of Tchehrin ז״ל

aligned_segments.he: קמ"ו וע"כ עכו"ם יכול לבטל ע"זאפילו אינה שלו ואפילו בעל רחו אבל מי שאינו עובד ע"ז כגון גר תושב או ישמעאל אינם יכולים לבטל.
aligned_segments.en: [§3] In many communities the custom is to recite the verses of Baruch Hashem l'olam Amen v'Amen — which contain 18 verses corresponding to the aspect of ches — as stated — and they conclude with much prayer for the revelation of His Kingship.

aligned_segments.he: כי באמת בחי' ע"ז היא בטלה מעיקרא וכלא חשיבא כנ"ל וכ"ש כי כל אלהי העמים אלילים.
aligned_segments.en: And then one prays the Maariv prayer — which Yaakov Avinu instituted — who engaged most in this — to bind himself to the intellect in every thing — as is explained within — and he merited to stand against Esav — the aspect of the yetzer hara — and take from him the birthright and blessing — and when fleeing from him went to the house of study of Ever and engaged greatly in Torah there — as our Sages taught.

aligned_segments.he: ועיקר בח'י יניקת כחה שהיאבשביל כח הבחירה כידוע הוא רק עי"ז, בעצמו שנמצאים בנ"א המאמיני' בה ועובדים אותה ובזה משפיעי' בה איזה בחי' יניקה וכח בשביל הבחירה וזה בחי' משארז"ל אלהיהם של עכו"ם הם מתקיימם על אלהיהם. היינו שהעבודים אותה משפיעים בהם איזה בחינת כח.
aligned_segments.en: And afterwards he came to the house of Lavan and merited to marry his wives there and through them to father the twelve tribes — upon whom is the essential revelation of His Kingship — and when departing from Beer Sheva he merited to encounter the site of the Holy Temple — which encompasses most completely all the rectifications mentioned above — and there he instituted the evening prayer.

aligned_segments.he: וזה בחינת כמוהם יהיו עושיהם כל אשר בוטח בהם כי הע"ז בעצמם אין להם שום כח וממש בבחי' פה להם ולא ידברו וכו' רק מה שנדמה להעובדים שיש בה איזה בחינת כח וממשות הוא עי,ז בעצמו שעובדים אותה ובוטחים בה שזה עיקר עשייתה בבחינת עושיהם כל אשר בוטח בהם.
aligned_segments.en:
סִימָן ס״א

[§1]
And therefore one must give the kohen the foreleg and the cheeks and the maw of the ox and the sheep — etc. — and it is explained in Likutay Torah of the Ari, Parshas Shoftim: the cheeks correspond to the three first [Keter, Chochmah, Binah] — and the foreleg corresponds to ChagaT — and the maw corresponds to NHY — where it rests.

aligned_segments.he: וע,כ הם עצמם דייקא יכולים לבטלה אבל לא מי שאינו עובד אותם. ועל כן אם נשברה מאליה אסורה ג"כ עד שיבטלוה.
aligned_segments.en: It emerges that they allude to the totality of the aspect of drawing these rectifications.

aligned_segments.he: כי מה בכך שנשברה מאליה הלא היא כשבורה ובזויה גם מעיקרא רק העיקר שעובדיה בעצמם יבטלו אותה. וע"כ המוצא ע"ז צריך שיבערנה ויאבדנה וצריך לשרש אחריה ולכנות לה שם גנאי.
aligned_segments.en: And therefore they are given to the kohen — for in the priesthood there is also the aspect of the totality of all of them — (see Maurai Or) — and through this the rectification of the eating of meat is completed in its fullness.

aligned_segments.he: כי צריך לבער ולבטל כל מיני אחיזת הסט"א והיצה,ר שהם בחי' ע"ז עד שלא ישאר להם שום שורש וענף כלל כי היום אומר ל ועשה כך וכו' וכן צריכין לכנות לה שם גנאי כיהיא עצמה כלא ממש רק שעיקר כחה ע"י השם שקורין לה העובדים אותה ומכנין אותה בשם אלוה. וענין השם של כל דבר הוא בשרשו דבר גדול כי שם מרמז לבחי' חכמה ולבחי' מלכות בחי' כבוד כנ"ל.
aligned_segments.en: And therefore the chayah and fowl — in which the hold of the sitra achra is not as strong — as stated — do not require this rectification.

aligned_segments.he: וע,כ אנשים גדולים ומכובדיטם נקראים אנשי שם. וע"כ צריכין לכנות שם ע"ז לגנאי וביזיון היפוך החן והכבוד הנ"ל וע"כ אסור להזכר שמה מכש"כ שלא לשבע בשם ע"ז ואפילו שלא לגרום לעכו"ם שישבע בשם ע"ז כמבואר בשו"ע:
aligned_segments.en: And therefore the obligation is upon the slaughterer to give these gifts to the kohen — for he is the one engaged in the rectification of the animal through the shechitah — to sweeten the judgments at their root — to nullify from it the hold of foolishness and the sitra achra.

aligned_segments.he: סימן קמ"ח וכו'
וע,כ אסור לישא וליתן עמהם ביום חגם וכו' וכן עוד כמה הלכות המבוארים בסימנים אלו ולהלן והכל בכדי שלא יהיה לנו שום חלק בשמחתם ועבודתם ושלא ליתןלהם שום כח ושום אחיזה כלל. וזה בחי' הלאו של לא תחנם.
aligned_segments.en: And therefore he must complete the rectification through the gifts to the kohen — the man of kindness — and this is the aspect of: "for the kohen's lips shall guard knowledge — and Torah shall be sought from his mouth" [Malachi 2:7].

aligned_segments.he: תחנם דייקא שלא להמשיך עליהם בחינת חן בחי' החי"ת והנו"ן הנ"ל. כי הם ההיפוך מבחי' החן דקדושה. ועיין ע"ז דך כ' שדרז"ל לא תחנם לא תתן להם חנייה בקרקע. ד"א לא תחנם לא תתן להם חן ד"א לא תחנם לא תתן להם מתנות חנם ועיין שו"ע סימן קנ"א והכל סובב על ענין הנ"ל:

aligned_segments.en: (See section 28.)

aligned_segments.he: סימן קנ"ז
על כל עבירות שבתורהוכו' יעבור ואל יהרג וכו'.
aligned_segments.en: [§4] And this is the aspect of Tefillas Reshus [voluntary prayer] — for our Sages taught: "make your prayer not fixed — but [in the manner of] mercy and supplications" — etc. — for a prayer and request that is in the manner of fixed obligation does not have as much chen in the eyes of the One being petitioned to receive it. But when one prays in the manner of mercy and supplications — then the words have more chen — as we find even in a mortal king — Achashverosh — when Esther wished to achieve her request before him with mercy, she multiplied words of chen and mercy and supplications — as it is said: *"if it pleases the King, and if I have found favor in his eyes..."* [Esther 7:3]. And our Sages therefore expounded on Va'eschanan [Devarim 3:23]: "the righteous, even though they have many merits, petition before the Omnipresent only in mercy and supplications." And this too is in the general sense of what is written: "words of the wise are heard in quietness" — in its plain meaning.

aligned_segments.he: כי נשמת ישראל וחיותם הק' נמשך ממקור החכמה העליונה שמשם שורש כל התורה.
aligned_segments.en: It follows that even Shacharis and Minchah — which were instituted as obligations — one must nonetheless pray them in mercy and supplications — not like one who wishes to pay off a debt. And Yaakov instituted the prayer itself such that it should not be an obligation upon a person at all — only in the manner of voluntary [reshus] — and then if a person wishes to pray, it will certainly be from the generosity of his heart and his good will — and he will certainly pray in the manner of mercy and supplications — and his prayer will be accepted — through his meriting chen — and thus all the aspects mentioned above — as explained within. However, today the evening prayer has also been accepted as obligatory — as our Sages taught.

aligned_segments.he: וע"F פיקוח נפש אחת מישראל דוחה שבת וכן כל המצוות אך אם העכו"ם מכוין להעבירו על דת אז אם הוא בפני עשרה מישראל ע"כ אם ישמע להעכו"ם יש חילו השם בדבר ונמצא ממילא פוגם מאחד בשורש חיותו כי כל מה שברא הקב"ה לא ברא אלא לכבודו. והכבוד הוא בחי' חכמה כידוע ע"כ אפילו על ערקתא דמסאני (שישראל נוהגין כדי שיהיה הפרש ביניהם לבין העכו"ם) יהרג ואל יעבור. וכן על ע"ז וג"ע וש"ד אפ י' בצינעה ואין העכו"ם מכוין אלא להנאתו יהרג ואל יעבור כי על ש,ד סברא הוא מאי חזית וכו' דילמא דמא דחברך סמיק טפי כי אולי חיותו של חבירו נמשך עוד מבחי' גבוה ביותר.
aligned_segments.en:
סִימָן ס״ב

[§1]
And therefore it is forbidden to eat a limb from a living animal — and flesh that separates from a living animal.

aligned_segments.he: וכן ע"י עז,ז ח"ו פוגם בוודאי בכל שורש חיותו כעיהוא ככופר בכל התורה כולה. וכן הפגם של ג"ע גדול מאד ופוגם בכל חיותו וכפוגם בכל התורה כולה וגורם בחי' פירוד ח"ו ביחוד הק' ומשפיע כח וחיות לסט"א ח"ו ע"כ יהרג ואל יעבור ועי"ז נעשה תיקון גדול למעלה כידוע. ומעלה בזה ניצוצות הק' הרבה ובחי' החיות דקדושה המלבוש בסטרא דמותא ג"כ ואז יתפרדו כל פועלי און ובלע המות לנצח וכל קרני רשעים אגדע תרוממנה קרנות צדיק
aligned_segments.en: For as long as the judgments have not been sweetened at their root through the rectifications of shechitah — it is impossible to separate the evil and foolishness that has seized the spirit of the creature — which is the hold of the spirit of folly — the stormy spirit from the sitra achra of Esav.

aligned_segments.he: סימן קנ"ח

וע"כ אסור לרפאות את העכו"ם ולהצילו מן המיתה. מאחר שהם בעצם בבחינת סטרא דמותץא אבל אף על פי כן אין מצוה להורגם כי מסתמא יש גם בהם איזה צורך להעולם בשביל קיום הבחירה. אבל המינים והאפיקורסים והמוסרים ועוברי עבירות להכעיס מצוה לסבב מיתתם. כי מאחר שעוקרים עצמם מקדושת ישראל הדבקים במקור החיים דקדושה וירדו ברשעתם לתכלית שפלות מדריגת בחי' סטרא דמותא ע"כ מצוה לבערם טן העולם בכדי שלא תתגבר ביותר בחי' סטרא דמותא בעולם ר"ל.
aligned_segments.en: And therefore such eating greatly damages the soul.

aligned_segments.he: וע"כ העובר עבירה רק לתיאבון כי לא יכול להתגבר על יצרו אסגור לעמוד על דמו ומצוה להצילו כי הוא דבוק עדיין בקדושת ישראל ובבחי' החיים דקדושה רק שלא יכול להתגבר על יצרו ולכבוש את בחירתו ובוודאי יקבל ענשו אבל אעפ"כ גם בשעת העבירה יש לו צער מזה שבא לידי מדה זו ויודע כי מרה תהיה באחרונה ואולי יזכה עוד לחרטה באמת ולתשובה שלימה וכ"ש (קהלת ט') כי מי אשר יחובר אל כל החיים יש בטחון ופירש רש"י אפילו הוא רשע ונתחבר לרשעים וכו' יש בטחון שמא ישוב לפני מותו.
aligned_segments.en: And also: because it is an extreme act of cruelty — which is from the quality of wild and impure animals — that tear and eat while alive — and these animals are the very opposite of the aspects of holy Chochmah and holy life-force — from which is the root of mercy and kindness and the nullification of all types of anger and rage and cruelty — as stated many times.

aligned_segments.he: היינו כנ"ל.
aligned_segments.en: And therefore one must be especially diligent in learning at night — to subdue the sitra achra — whose essential dominion is then — for *"in it all the beasts of the forest stir"* [Tehillim 104:20] — and to give strength to holy Malchus — the attribute of night.

aligned_segments.he: ובזה מבואר שם כל ענין הפסוק כי לכלב חי טוב מן האריה המת כי החיים יודעי םשימותו והמתים אינם יודעים מאומה.
aligned_segments.en: And therefore one must connect night and day through Torah — to unite the [Divine] Beloved couple through Torah — as stated.

aligned_segments.he: היינו כי כל זמן שלא עקר את עצמו מן החים דקדושה לגמרי אע"פ שלא יכול להתגבר על יצרו אעפ"כ היה לו צער מזה כי יודע שעומד למיתה וליתן דין וחשבון עלכל דבר ע"כ הוא בבחי' הכלב החי שהוא במדריגה פחותה ושפלה מאדכמובן במה שארז"ל מהו לסרוסי כלבא ואעפ"כ הוא טיוב מן האריה המת. היינו ממי שעוקר את עצמו מן החיים דקדושה לגמרי והוא מין או בעל עבירות להכעיס שאז אע"פ שהוא חי ומתגבר ומצליח מאד אעפ"כ הוא בבחי' אריה המת ומצוה לבערו מן העולם שלא יבאיש את הארץ אבל אם אינו עובר רק לתיאבון ולא להכעיס שיודע שימות ומתיירא מזה אז הוא עדיין בכלל התחברות אל כל החיים ויש לו תקוה ובטחון לשוב בתשובה ומצוה להצילו ולהחיותו כנ"ל
aligned_segments.en: And therefore one who engages in Torah at night — a thread of chesed is drawn over him — etc. — which is the aspect of chen — as it is said: *"and He showed him kindness and gave him grace"* [Bereishis 39:21] — and in Esther it is said: *"and she carried chen and chesed before him"* [Esther 2:17].

aligned_segments.he: סימן קנ"ט וכו'

ענין איסור רבית. כי ע"י שמלוין לעני או אף לעשיר כשצריך ללוות שזה בעצמו בחי' עניות כל זה נמשך בשרשו מבחי' העניו' של בחי' מלכות דקדושה שהיא בבחי' מסכן וחכם כנ"ל ובאתערותא דלתתא איתער לעילא ועל כן ע,י צדקה וגמ"ח עי"ז נמשך ומאיר הארת בחי' החכמה העליונה (ששם שורש בחינת העשירות כשארז"ל כיון שנתחכה נתעשר וכו') על בחי'המלכות דקדושה ואז הוא עולה מבחי' עניות ונעשה אור הלבנה כאור החמה שזה בחי' חן כנ"ל. וע"כ נקרא הלואה כזו בלשון חכמים בשם הלואת חן וכן בלשון הכתוב טוב איש חונן ומלוה.
aligned_segments.en:
סִימָן ס״ג

[§1]
And since the essential strengthening of the sitra achra in eating is in the eating of meat — as stated — one must guard it: and meat that was out of sight is forbidden unless according to the circumstances explained in the Shulchan Aruch — since we fear that perhaps it was exchanged through the aspect of the transpositions and substitutions of the sitra achra — and its palaces of transposition — which provoke to exchange and substitute — etc. — as is known.

aligned_segments.he: וזה וכי ימוך אחיך וכו' והחזקת בו וכו' וחי עמך ועיקר החיות מבחינת החכמה תחיה וכו' כנ"ל.
aligned_segments.en: [§1] For sleep is one sixtieth of death — for at night the sitra d'mosa has dominion — from which is the nourishment of Esav — the yetzer hara. And therefore before lying down to sleep one must accept upon himself the yoke of Heavenly Kingship through Shema.

aligned_segments.he: וזה אל תקח מאתו נשך ותרבית כי על ידי זה אדרבא הוא מושך ויונק החית של תמצית הדם שלו.
aligned_segments.en: Moreover, Shema is the aspect of the drawing-down of the mochin — as is known — which is the aspect of binding oneself to the aspect of the light of the holy intellect. And likewise Shema is the aspect of the totality of the holy Torah — as stated. And then: *"in peace I shall lie down and sleep"* [Tehillim 4:9] — and one need not fear that the sitra d'mosa will grip him entirely during sleep, G-d forbid — in the aspect of: *"lest I sleep the sleep of death"* [Tehillim 13:4] — G-d forbid — but on the contrary, sleep is a great benefit for his mochin — for then his soul enters into faith — the aspect of Malchus — and is renewed there — and through this specifically he merits to receive new mochin and new life-force — as is known.

aligned_segments.he: ונתגדל עי"ז עניותו ביותר וזה ויראת מאלהיך בחי'מוראה של מלכות.
aligned_segments.en:
סִימָן ס״ד, ס״ה וְכוּ׳

[§1]
The matter of the prohibition of fat and blood is somewhat explained above.

aligned_segments.he: וחי אחיך עמך בחי' החכמה תחיה.
aligned_segments.en: And likewise the thigh-sinew is forbidden — because Yaakov our father was pained in it when he wrestled with the guardian-prince of Esav — which is the aspect of the yetzer hara.

aligned_segments.he: וזה שסיים אני ה' אלהיכם דרז"ל שבמצוה זו מקבל על עצמו עול מלכות שמים אם לאו להיפוך ח"ו היינו כנ"ל. וזה שאמרז"ל על המלוה ברבית כאלו כופר בתחיית המתים.
aligned_segments.en: And this sinew corresponds to Tisha b'Av — on which our holy Temple was destroyed — which encompasses all these rectifications — as explained in the section of Orach Chaim.

aligned_segments.he: ששרשה מבחי' החכמה תחיה. וביציאת מצרים.
aligned_segments.en: [§2] And according to this approach, all that one additionally recites at the time of Shema — as explained in the Shulchan Aruch — as well as the confessional [Vidui] and the blessing HaMapil — are self-evident. And the conclusion: "Who illuminates the whole world in His glory" — as it is explained in Mishnas Chassidim and the Siddur of the Ari: these [letters] correspond to the 32 paths of Chochmah — as the numerical value of kavod [glory] — meaning one binds oneself to the light of holy Chochmah. And in the Siddur Kol Yaakov it is explained: "in His glory" refers to Malchus — meaning the aspect of holy Malchus mentioned above.

aligned_segments.he: שהוא בחי' עליות המלכות כידוע.
aligned_segments.en:
סִימָן סו וְכוּ׳ — הִלְכוֹת כְּתוּבּוֹת

[§1]
The laws of kesubos. It is forbidden to be secluded — etc. — before writing her a kesubah — etc. For since the yetzer hara and the sitra achra — who are of the sitra d'piruda — lurk greatly to cause separation between those who are bound in holy connection. And behold: holy Malchus — the aspect of the bride — is in the aspect of the poor wise man — having nothing of its own — only what she receives from Chochmah — from which is the root of her husband — who is the groom.

aligned_segments.he: וזה לנכרי תשיך כי עי"ז מוציא ממנו ניצוצי בחינת החיות דקדושה שנפלו לשם.
aligned_segments.en:
And since the sitra achra greatly lurks on this — to damage and corrupt the aspect of holy connection — and cause separation between them — therefore one fears that perhaps the yetzer hara will become so aroused that he may send her away from his home — and she will remain in utter poverty and destitution — since she will have no one from whom to receive her sustenance.

[§2]
And because of this concern — one must fear that even during the time of their connection and attachment — there will not be complete connection. For the essential fullness of union is in the thought — that both be in one thought of love and brotherhood and companionship of holiness. But if the thought and anxiety mentioned confuses her — lest it occur to him to divorce her and she will remain lacking everything — through this their union will not be complete. Therefore the Sages enacted the kesubah for her — so that it not be easy in his eyes to send her away. And then she is assured that the union is a complete union.

aligned_segments.he: אבל לאחיך לא תשיך.
aligned_segments.en:
And also: even if — G-d forbid — there should be separation between them through divorce or death — G-d forbid.

[§3]
She will not be in utter destitution. Since they will give her the kesubah — and she will have some sustenance and life-force from the impression of her husband's sustenance. And therefore our Sages taught: all who diminish from the measure of the kesubah (even with her consent) — his cohabitation is licentious cohabitation — as stated. For their union is not complete. And therefore: the Sages enacted for a virgin who became a vessel only through this husband (as our Sages taught: "a woman makes a covenant only with the one who made her a vessel" — meaning her first husband) — she has two hundred zuz — the measure of the aspect of wealth — opposite poverty — as our Sages taught: all who have two hundred zuz shall not take from charity — for one is no longer in the category of poverty — since one has such an amount.

aligned_segments.he: על כן המלוה ברבית כאלו כופר באלהי ישראל כשארז"ל.
aligned_segments.en: And for a widow — whose initial rectification was through her first husband — and therefore when she marries this one afterwards — she has only a maneh. And therefore our Sages enacted several matters between husband and wife — for the sake of chin [grace] — that they have grace with each other. For this is the essential holy union — the aspect of the connection of ches and nun mentioned — the aspect of chen — as stated. And this is what is cited in the Shulchan Aruch, Siman 69 — that the husband incurs ten obligations to his wife — corresponding to the aspect of Chochmah — the aspect of Yud — as is known. And he gains from her four things — the aspect of dalet — for she is to him in the aspect of dalet — the aspect of the poor wise man — as stated.

aligned_segments.he: מאחר שפוגם בבחי' התיקונים שצריך איש הישראלי לדבק בהם בכדי להתקרב אליו ית' ולהכיר אותו יתברך עי"ז כנ"ל:
aligned_segments.en: [§1] For our Sages taught: "A man and woman — if they merited — the Shechinah dwells between them" — for in their root they allude to the supernal union.

aligned_segments.he: וע,Fאסור גם רבית מוקדמת ומאוחרת.
aligned_segments.en: But if they did not merit, G-d forbid — fire consumes them — the heat of the yetzer hara, G-d forbid. And therefore a person must sanctify himself then and be especially modest — in the aspect of: *"and with the modest is wisdom"* [Mishlei 11:2].

aligned_segments.he: כי ע"י רבית פוגם בבחינת חכמה ומלכות שהם בחינת אחור וקדם כידוע.
aligned_segments.en: For through this he merits to bind himself to the light of the holy intellect — and to draw through this holy offspring — for the drop flows from the brain — the aspect of Chochmah — and flows to the woman who fears Hashem — whose root is from the aspect of holy Malchus. And therefore when the union is in holiness, holy children are born from it — who accept upon themselves the complete yoke of Heavenly Kingship — and merit to bind themselves to the light of the holy intellect in every thing — as stated.

aligned_segments.he: וע"F גם רבית דברים אסורים כי הדיבור כלול גם כן משני הבחינות הנ"ל.
aligned_segments.en:
סִימָן ס״ט וְכוּ׳

[§1]
And therefore meat requires washing and salting — in order to wash away the visible blood upon it — which is forbidden as stated — and also to soften the meat so that the salt can extract the blood from it. For even though the meat has already been purified from the visible blood upon it — even so one must extract from it also the seeping blood [dam pelitah] — for even though the blood of the organs that has not seeped out is permitted — for this is the aspect of: *"He has not looked upon iniquity in Yaakov"* — and our Sages taught: evil thought — Hashem does not join it to action — for since it has not seeped out to bring the evil into actual deed — G-d forbid — in actual action — one is not punished for this since one prevailed over one's inclination in deed at least.

aligned_segments.he: וזה שאמרו רז"ל (בבא מציעא דף ס"א) הקשו מלוי ברבית לשופכי דמים כי לא די שא ינו ממשיך חיות להלוה בבחי' וחי אחיך עמך אדרבא יונק ממנו תמצית חיותו ביותר ע"י הרבית.
aligned_segments.en: Even so: one must purify the heart also from such thoughts — G-d forbid — and subdue also the evil within it that is only in potential — not in actual deed. For otherwise — G-d forbid — it is easy for the yetzer hara to prevail over one even in actual deed — G-d forbid. And this is the aspect of what one must salt the meat — so that it also expels the blood absorbed in the organs — for at the beginning of cooking — certainly the blood within it will seep and move from place to place and will forbid.

aligned_segments.he: וזה שארז"ל (שם דף ע"א) בא וראה סמיות עינים של מלוי ברבית.
aligned_segments.en:
And therefore salting is required — and the salt — through its pungency and saltiness — extracts even the blood absorbed in the organs.

[§2]
And likewise regarding the spiritual matter for the person: the salting is in the aspect of what our Sages taught: "let a person always arouse his yetzer tov against his yetzer hara" — meaning: one should not wait until the moment one sees one's inclination wanting to overpower and bring one to sin in actual deed — and only then gird one's battle weapons to fight it. But rather: while one's inclination is still only in potential — not yet in actual deed — at that point one arouses one's yetzer tov — and provokes it — and initiates battle against it — in order to drive it away entirely — so that it does not rule over one even only in the aspect of potential. And this is what is said: "tremble" — and certainly then: "and do not sin" — etc.

[§3]
And likewise: one who studies Torah with force and effort — and accepts upon himself suffering and bitterness for the sake of the yoke of Torah — as our Sages taught: "Torah only endures in one who kills himself over it." This too is the aspect of the rectification of the meat through salting as stated — as understood in the discourse Vayomar Boaz, Siman 65.

aligned_segments.he: סמיות עינים דייקא.
aligned_segments.en:
(And see the holy Zohar, Vayechi 241 — regarding the sweetening of the judgments in the aspect of Malchus — which is through the aspect of salt — and from this the matter of salting is also understood.) And then after salting — one must go back and wash the meat and clean it of the salt — and of this blood that was expelled from it. And then the meat is permitted for eating — for there is no longer any hold of Esav the man of blood — even only in the aspect of potential.

[§4]
And therefore: meat that sat three days without washing and salting — salting no longer helps it — for its blood has dried within it.

aligned_segments.he: היפוך מה שצריכין להסתכל בעינא פקיחא על השכל והחכמה דקדושה.
aligned_segments.en: And this is like what our Sages taught [Bava Kamma 82]: "and they walked three days in the wilderness and found no water" — etc. — since they walked three days without Torah — they grew tired. And our Sages standing among them arose and ordained — etc. — so that they not rest three days without Torah. And it is already explained: the rectification of meat through washing and salting is the aspect of subduing the yetzer hara — the aspect of Esav — whose essential subduing is through the waters of Torah and wisdom.

aligned_segments.he: וזה אדם קורא לחבירו רשע יורד עמו לחייו, כי רשע הוא מסטרא דמותא היפוך בחי' החיים דקדושה.
aligned_segments.en:
And therefore: if it sat three days — etc. — the aspect of having been separated from Torah in the three days mentioned — then certainly the blood within it has already hardened and dried — to the point that it is already difficult to extract and expel it — even through washing and salting. And therefore one may not eat it except roasted — and since one has roasted it — even so one should not cook it initially — as explained in the Shulchan Aruch. And therefore: if it was soaked in water within the three days — one is permitted to keep it until close to another three days.

[§5]
And from this matter something is understood: why sometimes specifically then — when one's inclination provokes one even more — with confusions and thoughts — etc. — things that had not entered one's mind before.

aligned_segments.he: וזה מביא עדים וכו' וכותב וחותם פלוני כפר באלהי ישראל היינו כנ"ל.
aligned_segments.en: And this is like the aspect of the rectification of salting — where at first — and especially after washing — the meat is clean and no moisture of blood is visible upon it — and then specifically through the salting the meat fills with brine and blood expelled from it. For at first the blood was absorbed in the organs — and now it has come out and been expelled through the salting — and therefore the meat became soiled again — until it is washed a second time — and then it will truly be clean of all blood — both outside and inside. (And this is somewhat explained in the conversations.) And therefore one must be especially careful at that time — not to allow any weakening of the mind to fall in one's heart through the aspect of this increased provocation.

aligned_segments.he: וזה שאמרו (שם דף ע"ה) ולא עוד אלא שמשימין משה רבינו חכם ותורתו אמת וכו'.
aligned_segments.en: For such is the matter — for this itself is its purification and rectification — as stated. But even so — one must not be pleased with this — G-d forbid.

aligned_segments.he: היינו שפוגמין בבחי' משה שהוא בחי' שמש בחי' הדעת והחכמה דקדושה ופוגמין בבחי' התורה שעל ידה נותנין כח להמלכות דקדושה עד שנעשה בחי' אור הלבנה כאור החמה כנ"ל.
aligned_segments.en: Rather: one must immediately strengthen against the confusions and drive them away with all one's power — and at least flee from them immediately to holiness. And at least one must not be as one who contemplates and returns and contemplates again — G-d forbid. And this is understood also from elsewhere.

aligned_segments.he: ול כן ארז,ל (במ"ר פ' משפטים) כל מי שנוטל רבית מעלה עליו הכתוב כאלו עשה כל הרעות והעבירות שבעולם וכו' והקב"ה אומר עד עכשיו הוא חי.
aligned_segments.en:
And this is the aspect of what one must salt in a perforated vessel specifically — so that there is a place for the brine and blood that are expelled to flow out. But if there is no place for it to flow out — then not only is what was soaked in the brine and blood forbidden — for the blood re-absorbed into it — and salting and roasting no longer help it. But even the entire piece outside the brine was also forbidden — for the blood within it moved from place to place and did not exit — since it had no place to flow out.

[§6]
And this corresponds to the spiritual matter: since one does not hasten to drive away all the confusions and soilings that come upon one's heart specifically now — but rather one appears as if — G-d forbid — one is pleased by this — then not only do they themselves cleave and seize in one's heart — to the point that it is hard to purify oneself from them afterward — but all one's brain and heart become confused and disordered through this even more.

[§7]
For since one engages in Torah and service somewhat — whose special quality is to subdue the yetzer hara and purify the heart from all dross — even from what is still only in potential — this itself is the cause and reason why it seems that they provoke and cling to one even more right now — as stated.

aligned_segments.he: היינו כנ"ל.
aligned_segments.en:
And if one were strong in this frame of mind — and each time some confusion comes upon one's heart — one drives it away immediately and gives it a place to flow and exit from oneself — and afterwards some other confusion would come upon one's heart and one would also drive it away — and so each time — until one merited true purity of heart — in the aspect of: *"and You shall cast into the depths of the sea all their sins"* [Michah 7:19] — to a place where — etc. — "and they shall never rise to the heart again." But if when some confusion comes — etc. — one does not immediately give it place to exit — but grasps it and deepens it and repeats its foolishness — G-d forbid — then one is like one who immerses while holding an impurity in one's hand.

[§8]
And from this it is self-evident: even though meat salted in a non-perforated vessel is permanently forbidden — and no rectification helps it — according to us — as stated. But with a person — certainly there is nothing that stands before repentance — and if one now truly strengthens oneself — and pierces one's stony heart — and engages in the service of Hashem in truth — certainly everything will be rectified.

aligned_segments.he: כי פוגם בזסה בכלל תיקוני התורה הק' שעל ידה זוכין לחיות דקדושה.
aligned_segments.en:
And therefore: if one has no salt — one roasts the meat over fire — for the power of fire also draws out the seeping blood — such that the blood absorbed in it will not seep and spread further.

[§9]
And therefore: regarding seeping blood [dam pelitah] — we say: since it is busy seeping it does not absorb — and likewise: as it absorbs so it expels. But not regarding visible blood — and likewise not regarding other prohibitions such as brine of neveilah and treifah. For with seeping blood — since before it seeped out it was not in the category of prohibition — for the blood of the organs that had not seeped was permitted — as stated — only since we are concerned that it will seep out afterwards — therefore one engages with it to extract and expel it — and therefore we are not as concerned about it.

aligned_segments.he: ומי שמלוה בלא רבית כאלו עשה כל המצוות כי זה בחינת כלל כל מצוות התורה הקדושה להמשיך על ידם בחינת התיקונים הנ"ל.
aligned_segments.en:
But regarding visible blood and other prohibitions — where the sitra achra has already seized them more strongly — one must keep far from them — and the arguments mentioned do not apply.

[§10]
And therefore: the liver — since it is full of blood — and in it is the essential hold of Esav the red one — as understood in the discourse Sha'alu, Siman 57 — and this is the aspect of: *"and Edom came out to meet him with a heavy people"* [Bamidbar 20:20] [am kaved — which also means liver] — therefore salting does not help for the liver — only roasting over fire — the aspect of: *"and the house of Yaakov shall be fire"* [Ovadyah 1:18] — etc. — "and the house of Esav shall be stubble" — etc.

[§11]
And therefore our Sages taught: blood is not retained in intestinal walls — for our Sages taught: intestinal walls are not flesh — and those who eat them are not fully human beings. And therefore: since they are not fully suited as human food — the bloods do not seize in them as strongly — unless we see that they reddened — which indicates there is in them the aspect of the hold of Esav the red one. And therefore one must salt intestinal walls on the outside — where the fat adheres — for their fat is regarded as blood — since there is the essential hold of: "and Yeshurun grew fat and kicked" — as stated.

aligned_segments.he: ועל כן ארז"ל שקולה צדקה כנגד כל התורה והמצוות וג"ח גדולה מן הצדקה עיין שם עוד במדרש הנ"ל ותבין לענינינו
aligned_segments.en: And therefore: visible blood that fell on roasting meat — we say the opposite: the fire absorbs it. For this is the aspect of: "one who provokes the yetzer hara within oneself" — for the fire of Torah and holy intellect subdues only the power of the sitra achra and the yetzer hara that is by nature in a person — and through this what happens naturally happens to it. But when a person deliberately seeks out and calls his inclination and awakens it upon himself — G-d forbid — then it can happen that it overpowers him even more specifically — as our Sages taught regarding one who teaches his daughter Torah: it is as if he taught her frivolity — as it is said: "I wisdom dwell with cunning" [Mishlei 8:12] — etc. — see there.

aligned_segments.he: סימן קע"ח
שלא ללבוש במלבושי עכו"ם.
aligned_segments.en: [§2] And therefore one was especially cautioned also regarding the sanctity of the woman's thought at that time — so that no hold of the aspect of the yetzer hara — the kingdom of the sitra achra — G-d forbid — should exist within it.

aligned_segments.he: כי המלבושים הם בבחינת מלכות ונמשכין בשרשם מבחי' החכמה העליונה כמבואר כבר כ"פ ועי' בהמעשה של הבנים שנחלפו מענין המלבוש שעושה החמה ללבנה שזה בחינת חדתותי דסיהרא ומבחינה זו שורש בחינת המלבושים של ישראל הדבקים בבחינה הנ"ל.
aligned_segments.en: And therefore one must engage much in Torah before intimacy — as is cited concerning the Ari — for through this one gives strength to holy Malchus — as stated.

aligned_segments.he: אבהל מלבושי עכו"ם וכל מנהגיהם נמשכין מבחי' חמה ולבנה דסט"א. וע,F אסור לילך בחוקותיהם:
aligned_segments.en: And therefore the primary times for intimacy are Shabbos and Yom Tov — etc. — for then is the time of the rectifications of Malchus and her ascent most fully — and likewise then is the time of the illumination of supernal Chochmah and the holy mochin most fully.

aligned_segments.he: סימן קע"ט
שלא לכשף ולעונן ולנחש וכו'.
aligned_segments.en:
סִימָן ע״ט וְכוּ׳

[§1]
The signs of a pure animal and chayah are chewing the cud and having a split hoof. For our Sages taught: examine the teeth and you will forget the shoes [meaning: the signs indicate each other]. And behold: a person has thirty-two teeth — corresponding to the thirty-two paths of Chochmah — from which is the essential rectification of eating — as all of this is explained in the kavanos. And through them is the essential power of the feet — for "the end is embedded in the beginning." And the light of holy Chochmah and holy Torah illuminate a person from the aspect of his head to his feet — the aspect of: *"a lamp to my feet is Your word — and a light to my path"* [Tehillim 119:105]. And this is the aspect of: "the wisdom of the prudent — he understands his way" [Mishlei 14:8] — the aspect of: "and the path of the righteous is as the shining light" — as explained within. And see in the discourse of the Ari at the end of the Tikkunim — on the verse: "I have pondered my ways and I have returned my feet" — etc. And also: Malchus corresponds to the aspect of the feet — as is known. And this is the aspect of our Sages' teaching: it was found to illuminate his eyes and make him stand on his feet.

[§2]
And behold: correspondingly — the kingdom of the sitra achra — the aspect of Esav — also encompasses these two aspects of the klippa. And this is the aspect of what is said [Daniel 7] regarding the fourth beast: "its great iron teeth — eating and crushing — and its remainder it trampled with its feet." And therefore: in cattle and beasts — in which the filth of Esav and the spirit of folly and foolishness — the opposite of holy Chochmah — which is the essential aspect of human being — seizes most — therefore when it has teeth or fangs in the upper jaw — since then it generally does not chew its cud — for it chews and grinds its food with its teeth very well — until the food digests easily within it — and does not return and rise again into its mouth.

aligned_segments.he: כי אנחנו צריכין לקשר עצמינו רק אל אור השכל דקדושה שיש בכל דבר כנ"ל לכן צריכין לילך בתמימות ולבלי לחקור אחר העתידות ולקבל הכל באהבה ובתמימות ואז נהיה לו ולחלקו כמו שפירש"י על פסוק תמים תהיה עם ה' אלהיך הינו כנ"ל כי מאחר שעיקר מטרת כוונתינו הוא רק להתקרב אליו יח' ע"י כל דבר א"כ איך אפשר לנו להשתדל בתחבולות ולחקור עתידות בפרט ע"י תחבולות רשע של כישוף וכיוצא רק צריכין לקבל הכל באהבה ולקשר עצמינו אל השי"ת בכל מה שעובר עלינו כי רק הוא ית' חלקינו ונועם גורלינו.
aligned_segments.en:
And therefore it does not chew its cud. And it also does not have split hooves — so that it has an especially strong hold with its hooves on the ground. And therefore these are signs of impurity — for this indicates that the spirit of the sitra achra has seized it greatly — that it is addicted to the pleasure of eating — and imagines it has a firm and complete footing in this world.

[§3]
But if it chews its cud — this is because it has no teeth in the upper jaw — and therefore it cannot thoroughly chew and grind its food — and therefore the food returns and rises again into its mouth each time. And its hooves are split — so that it does not have as firm a hold with its hooves. From this it is apparent that the spirit of animality in it does not have great power and hold — and especially in the matter of its eating — where is the essential hold of animality — and where is the essential hold of Esav. And therefore: when one sees these signs — from its teeth to its hooves — one thereby knows that it is pure — for the sitra achra has not ruled it so strongly — and it is therefore fit for Israel's eating. And one may also say: the matter of chewing its cud alludes to the quality of the righteous — who minimize eating and drinking — the aspect of: "a righteous person eats to satisfy his soul" [Mishlei 13:25] — and many times they fast entirely — for they accustom themselves to the quality of the World to Come — in which there is no eating and drinking. But even so — as long as they are in this world — they too are compelled to eat and drink — the aspect of: "when you arrive in the city — proceed according to its customs." And since for them it is only in the aspect of necessity — they suffice with a small amount. And the unpleasantness of being full equals for them — each time — what they already ate yesterday or many hours ago — which is the aspect of chewing the cud — being sustained from what one ate already.

aligned_segments.he: וע"כ באמת נארמ אצל יעקב שזכה לבחי' אור השכל הנ"ל ויעקב איש תם וכמובא במאמר הנ"ל על פסוק אשרי תמימי דרך.
aligned_segments.en:
[§4]
And also: since their eating is only out of necessity and not for their own pleasure — they are in the aspect of the angels when they came to Avraham our father in this world — they were compelled to eat — and it is said of them: "and they ate" — and our Sages taught: and did they actually eat? — but they appeared as eating. And the first of each [food] departed [within them immediately] — likewise the eating of the righteous: it only appears as physical eating like other people — but in truth they are utterly distant from it — and even during the eating their mind is bound above above — and they are nourished only from the light of supernal Chochmah. And this is also the aspect of chewing the cud — appearing as if eating and not eating.

[§5]
And the split hooves also indicate the quality of the righteous — who have no firm footing in this world — but are always in the aspect of: "spread out the split of Your kingdom" — for they have doubts and uncertainty — and division — also regarding their reward in the World to Come. And as our Sages taught: why is the letter lulav dotted [in the verse about the gifts to Yosef]? David said: I know there is reward for the righteous in the World to Come — but I do not know whether I have a share with them.

aligned_segments.he: ועל כן גם אחיזת עינים אסור.
aligned_segments.en: And Rabbi Yochanan ben Zakkai said: two paths are before me — etc. Whereas the quality of the wicked is all the opposite — for they are deeply addicted to the lusts of this world — and cannot satisfy themselves — the aspect of: "and the dogs — etc. — know not satisfaction" [Yeshayahu 56:11] — and: "and the belly of the wicked shall want" [Mishlei 13:25]. And this is the aspect of: an impure animal does not chew its cud — for immediately after it swallows the food — its memory is as if erased — and it only anticipates more food. And even during the eating it becomes completely seized and bound by the physical pleasure of eating — for it thoroughly chews the food with its teeth — and fulfils its desire to the extent possible. And even so: they know not satisfaction — and it is as if it ate nothing at all. And its hooves are closed — for it imagines its footing in this world is firm.

aligned_segments.he: כי פוגם בזה בבחי' עינים דקדושה וזה בחי' איסור דורש אל המתים.
aligned_segments.en:
And not only that — but it is confident that it will also have reward in the World to Come. And these aspects are signs of impurity.

[§6]
And therefore: all that chews its cud — it has a split hoof — except the camel — etc. — and all that has a split hoof — it chews its cud — except the pig — etc. — for our Sages taught: the camel — this is Babylon; the shafan [hyrax] — this is Persia; the arnevet [hare] — this is Greece; the pig — this is Edom. It emerges that these species allude to the totality of the kingdoms of the sitra achra. And since Israel must be in exile under their dominion — therefore there is in them some sign of purity — so that they not be as complete opposites of the holiness of Israel. And the very sign of purity indicates the aspect of the holy sparks that fell among them — for whose sake Israel must be subjugated under them — until they clarify all the holy sparks from among them — as is known.

aligned_segments.he: יכ מדבק עצמו עי"ז לבחי' סטרא דמותא היפוך בחי' החיים דקדושה.
aligned_segments.en:
And this also alludes to what the yetzer hara first dresses itself in mitzvos — as explained within — and this too is for this reason — for it is difficult for it to incite a person immediately at the first moment from one opposite to the other. And this is the aspect of our Sages' teaching about the pig — that it stretches out its hooves saying: see that I am pure — etc. — as stated.

[§7]
And therefore: an impure animal that gave birth to something resembling a pure animal — etc. — it is forbidden. For since its source is from the side of the sitra achra and impurity — therefore even the signs of purity do not help it — for they are in the aspect of the yetzer hara dressing in mitzvos — and in truth it is a mitzvah that comes through transgression. And therefore: a pure animal that gave birth to something resembling an impure animal — it is permitted. For since it is clearly known that its source is from the side of purity — one does not pay attention to the signs of impurity — for presumably they are in the aspect of: "great is transgression performed for its own sake" — and: "a prophet who was commanded to transgress the words of Torah temporarily — one listens to him." And our Sages taught: "there is a time to act for Hashem — they have nullified Your Torah" [Tehillim 119:126] — and similarly. And the matter of the chayah — whose fat is permitted and whose blood is forbidden — is already explained above.

aligned_segments.he: וזה בחי' בעד החים אל המתים וזה שמובא בזוה"ק שאני הני דאיקרון חיים. וע"כ אסור להתרפאות בדברי תורה אם לא משום פיקוח נפש. כי כיון שכבר נפגע ועבר עליו בחי' שליטת הסט"א שמשם שורש כל הסירוים וחולאים ר"ל שכל זה בא על ידי ביטול תורה כמו שארז,ל יתלה בביטול תורה וע,כ איך אפשר לו לקבל רפואה על ידי סגולת אמירת דברי תורה לבד שיאמר על המכה רק צריך לשוב תחלה בתשובה שלימה על מעשיו ויקבל עליו עול תורה באמת ואז ממילא יקבל רפואה כ"ש ושב ורפא לו וכתיב רפאות תהי לשריך וכו' וכשארז"ל. וע,כ להגן עליו מן המזיקין שלא יפגעו בו מותר לקרות פסוקים. כי בוודאי על ידי ד"ת מגרשין הסט"א כמו שארז"ל כל העוסק בד"ת מזיקין בדלין ממנו וזה כיכל הגוים וכו' אל מעוננים ואל קוסמים ישמעו ואתה לא כן נתן לך וכו' נביא וכו' כמוני יקים לך וכו' ונתתי דברי בפניו וכו'. כי הקב"ה מודיע עתידות לישראל ע"י ניבאיו הק' שמקבלין כחם מבחינת משה רבינו ששרשו בבחי' החכמה העליונה בחי'פני משה כפני חמה שזה בחי' ונביא לבב חכמה כעין שדרשו רז"ל:
aligned_segments.en: [§3] And therefore the Shulchan Aruch cautions that one should be especially careful not to intend for one's own pleasure — etc. — only to fulfil the command of one's Creator — etc. — so that the yetzer hara — the kingdom of the sitra achra — should have no hold therein — in the aspect of: "the fool desires not wisdom but only the disclosure of his heart" [Mishlei 18:2].

aligned_segments.he: סימן ק"פ
וע,כ אסור כתוב קעקע וקריחה על מת או לע"ז.
aligned_segments.en:
סִימָן פ״ב

[§1]
And therefore fowl — which are light of movement and the light of life shines in them greatly — as stated — therefore there are very many species of pure ones among them.

aligned_segments.he: כי זה מחוקות העכו"ם הדבוקים בסטרא דמותא בחי' ימותו ולא בחכמה ע"כ רושמין בגופם לשם זכרון המתים או הע"ז.
aligned_segments.en: And only twenty-four impure species exist — which have some hold from the power of fierce judgments — that extend from the aspect of twenty-four courts [of judgment] — as is known.

aligned_segments.he: אבל ישראל הדבקים באלהים חיים עד שגם במיתתן קרוים חיים ע"כ אסור להם כל זה.
aligned_segments.en: But since there are also impure species among them — therefore one who does not recognize them checks: any bird of prey that seizes — is certainly of an impure species — for one sees in it the quality of cruelty of wild animals — for the sake of eating.

aligned_segments.he: וזה בנים אתם וכו' לא תתגודדו וכו' כי מיתתם הוא רק כמו מי ששולח המלך אחר בנו לחזור לביתו לשלום להשתעשע עמו וכו' וכמו שדרשו רז"ל על זה
aligned_segments.en: And likewise: if it catches from the air and eats immediately — without first placing on the ground — from all this it is apparent that it is greatly addicted to eating — and this is a sign of impurity. For it is from the sitra achra of Esav — as stated — and it is thereby known that it is a bird of prey and impure.

aligned_segments.he: סימן קפ"א

איסור גילוח הפאות והזקן. עיין בכוונות. כי שערות הראש הם מבחי' גבורות ודינים. ועל כן צריכין לגלחם. כי מבחינת התגברות הדיינם ביותר יונק משם בחי' הסט"א בחי' עשו איש שעניר רק שצרייכן להשאיר הפאות שמרמזין לבחי' מלכות. היינו כי בנין בחינת המלכות שעל ידה זוכין לקבל מאור החכמה. היא מבחינת גבורות כידוע. שזה בחי' דינא דמלכותא. ע,כ אסור לגלח הפאו. ושערות הזקן הם בבחי' חסד ורחמים ששרשם מבחי' החכמה שזה בחי' זקן זה קנה חכמה בבחי' הדרת פנים בחי' חכמת אדם תאיר פניו וע"כ אסור לגלחן. גם שערות הזקן מרמזין לשלש עשרה מדות שהתורה נדרשת בהם בחי' עסק התורה הנ"ל. וכן מרמזין לשלש עשרה מדות של רחמים שהם שורש כלל בחי' התפלה, וע"כ אין ממנין שליח ציבור אא"כ נתמלא זקנו כמבואר בשו"ע או"ח סי' נ"ג. נמצא שבהפאות והזקן מרומזין כל התיקונים הנ"ל שהם בח'י כלל קדושת ישראל כנ"ל.
aligned_segments.en: And if it is known not to be a bird of prey: there are three signs of purity — etc. — and even so one may not eat it except by tradition — for we fear that perhaps it is from the aspect of the yetzer hara dressing itself in mitzvos and signs of purity — as stated.

aligned_segments.he: סימן קפ"ב
לא ילבש גבר שמלת אשה וכו' כי איש ואשה שרשם מבחי' חמה ולבנה בחי' שכל ומלכות ומשם שרש בחי' המלבושים כנ"ל ע"כ צריך כל אחד לשמור את בחינתו שלא להמיר ולהחליף ולצאת מגבותו ח"ו.
aligned_segments.en: [§4] And even if one's intent is so as not to desire a transgression — seeing one's yetzer overcoming [him] — etc. — it would be better to suppress and conquer one's yetzer — for "man has a small limb — when he satisfies it, it hungers" [Sanhedrin 107a] — etc. — see there in the Shulchan Aruch — for how can one subdue one's yetzer through immediately fulfilling the desire and will of the yetzer hara?

aligned_segments.he: כי על ידי זה תינק הסט"א ח"ו שזה בח'י יחוד דסט"א בח'י ניאוף ח"ו ועיין בליקוטי הלכות יורה דעה על ענין זה ובחו"מ הלכות פקדון על מאמר הזה הנ"ל ותבין ביותר.
aligned_segments.en: And therefore our Sages truly taught: "always let a person incite the good inclination against the evil inclination." However there is also reward in this [where needed] — but one who has no need to and arouses his desire — that is the counsel of the yetzer hara — who will lead him from what is permitted toward what is forbidden.

aligned_segments.he: סימן קפ"ג וכו'
הלכו תנדה.
aligned_segments.en:
סִימָן פ״ג

[§1]
And therefore also in fish — which were created only from water and are in the aspect of the open eye — as stated — even so there are among them impure species as well — for this reason — and therefore holy Torah gave signs for them: "all that has a fin and scales" [Vayikra 11:9].

aligned_segments.he: עיין זוהר פנחס דף רכ"ו ע"ב בני נדה וכו' דנד ה"א מאתרהא דאיהו מטרוניתא יצר הטוב ועאלא באתרהא שפחה יצה"ר ורזא דמילא כנגע נראה לי בבית והיינו דם טמא דנדה וכו' מבואר כי טומאת נדה הוא מבחי' היצה,ר בחי' מלכות דסט"א בחי' שפחה כי תירש גבירתה. וזה בחי' מה שמובא כי עשו שתה מבחי' הדמים טמאים דם נדה שבבטן רבקה וע"כ היה אדמוני ואיש הדמים, וע"כ טומאת נדה הוא בבחי' נגע כנ,ל כי נגע הוא בבחי' ההיפוך מענג שהוא בחי'חכמה דקדושה כידוע.
aligned_segments.en: The scales are crowns and protection for their flesh — and the fin enables them to swim swiftly and flee from those who pursue them.

aligned_segments.he: וע,F בני נדה מצורעים כמו שארז"ל. ומחמת שעיקר אחיזת היצה"ר הוא אק בהשבע מדות בבחי' כי שבע יפול צדיק וקם כידוע כי בבחי' מהוחין שהם למעלה מן המדות אין לו שום אחיזה כלל.
aligned_segments.en: And therefore they are signs of purity — for the wise person has eyes in his head — and knows that the world is full of enormous trials and dangers — for there are many enemies and lurkers and inciters and accusers against a person.

aligned_segments.he: כי אין אדם עובר עבירה אא"כ נסתלקין המוחין ממנו ונכנס בו שגעון ורוח שטות. וע,כ שבעת ימים תהיה בנדתה.
aligned_segments.en: And therefore he is careful for his soul — to hold a shield and barrier and armor to protect himself.

aligned_segments.he: ומדין תורה יש חילוקי דינים הרבה ביןנדה לזבה והכל מבואר ע"פ הנ"ל אך אין כאן מקום לבאר בזה וכבר אמרו רז"ל בנות ישראל החמירו על עצמן שאפי' רואות טפת דם כחרדל יושבת עליהם ז' נקיים. כי כך דרכו של היהצ"ר היום אומר לו עשה כך וכו' ובתחלה דומה לחוט של עכביש ואח"כ וכו'.
aligned_segments.en: And likewise: he hastens each time to flee from what one must flee from — and be saved.

aligned_segments.he: וכמ ושארז"ל וע"כ צריך ליזהר ממנו ולטהר עצמו מטומאתו אפילו בכל שהוא. וזה בחי' הז' נקיים לטהר כל המדות שהם בחי' שבעת ימים שלא יהיה בהם שום אחיזת הרע כלל בפרט מי שכבר נכשל באחיזת היצה"ר אפילו בכל שהוא צריך לדקדק ביותר על עצמו ולהתחרט מאד ולשוב בתשובה על העבר וליזהר בנפשו מאד על להבא שלא ליתן מקום לאחיזת היצר בשום מדה ממדותיו אפילו בכל שהוא רק כולם יהיו נקיים וטהורים.
aligned_segments.en:
Not so the fool who walks in darkness — and pays no attention to any of this — as the verse says: *"a wise person is fearful and turns from evil — and a fool is confident and reckless"* [Mishlei 14:16].

[§2]
And this is the aspect of: "all who have scales — have fins" — for one who has no scales to protect himself constantly — certainly it is difficult to be saved and one falls most times into the hands of one's enemies and stumbles in what one stumbles in.

aligned_segments.he: ואח"כ יטבול עצמו במים טהורים שיש בהם ארבעים סאה שכל גופו עולה בהם היינו שיבטל כל גשמיות גופו רק לבחי' מימי התורה הקדושה שהם בחי' ארבעים סאה שכל סאה הוא ששה קבים וכן כל קב הוא ארבעה רביעים שזה בחי' ארבעים יום של מתן תורה וכל יום הוא של כ"ד שעות שזה בחי' ארבעים סאה הנ"ל.
aligned_segments.en: And then one automatically weakens afterwards even in using one's fins to flee from them — for on the contrary — G-d forbid — since: "one sin draws another" — as our Sages taught.

aligned_segments.he: גם המים הם בחי' מימי הדעת דקדושה בחי' השכל העליון הנ"ל שעי"ז גמר טהרתו כי התורה הק' והשכל דקדושה מאירין לו בכל דרכיו עד שזוכה להתקרב להשי"ת ע"י כל דבר שבעולם אפילו ע,י דברים גופניים שזה בחי' מים שכל גופו עולה בהם כנ"ל. וזה בחי' ענין קביעות הוסתות של האשה.
aligned_segments.en: And the essential shield and armor before the enemy — the yetzer hara — is holy Torah — as the verse says: *"He stores away sound wisdom for the upright — a shield to those who walk in integrity"* [Mishlei 2:7].

aligned_segments.he: כי לכל עת ויש עתים לטובה ועתים לרעה ח"ו והכל כפי בחי' עליית המלכות וירידתה ח"ו שזה בחי' הימים של מילוי הלבנה ושל חסרונה שזה בחי' בנין המלכות דקדושה וחורבנה ח"ו כמבואר בזה הרבה בדברי רז"ל. וענין העתים הללו הם עוברים על כל אחד כפי בחינתו בעתים הללו שיודע בנפשו שרגיל בהם שיתגרה בו יצרו ביותר שזה מבחי' עתים לרעה והעיקר הוא בהתחלת העתים הנ"ל.
aligned_segments.en:
And this is what our Sages asked: since it is already written scales — why also write fin? — and they answered: yagdil Torah v'yadir [to magnify the Torah and make it glorious].

[§3]
Meaning: holy Torah alludes to us all the counsel and strategies needed for this battle — and therefore even though it is already self-evident that all who have scales have fins — even so holy Torah explains it explicitly — to make known that even this counsel — to flee when one must flee — all of it is only through the power of holy Torah — through which one gives strength to holy Malchus — the aspect of the yetzer tov — to prevail against the yetzer hara — as stated.

aligned_segments.he: וע"כ ארז"ל סתם וסת של עונה בינונית הוא אחת לשלים יום שזשהם כלל הימים של מילוי הלבנה וחסרונה כנ"ל. ויש גם וסתות הגוף כגון ע"י אכילה יתירה וכיוצא.
aligned_segments.en: And this: yagdil Torah — and through this: v'yadir — which is from the language of strengthening and power — and also from the language of rule and mastery — the aspect of the holy power that Malchus receives through this — as stated.

aligned_segments.he: וכמו כן גם ברוחניות יש שיודע בנפשו שלפעמים כשנכשל באיזה אכילה ושתיה יתירה וכיוצא באיזה דבר גופני אזי מתגרה יצרו בו ביותר. בפרט כשהוא יודע שנכשל כבר כמה פעמים ח"ו ע"י דברים כאלו.
aligned_segments.en: And this is what our Sages taught: from where [do we know] that scales are a garment? — as it is written: "and an armor of scales" [Shmuel I 17:5] — it is thereby explained: scales are the aspect of a shield and armor and coat of mail.

aligned_segments.he: ע"כ מלבד שצריך ליזהר להשמר מזה הרבה אף גם כשכבר נכשל ח"ו עוד הפעם בענין הגופניהזהאף שהוא דבר של רשות והיתר אעפ"כ צריך אח"כ תיכף בדיקה וזהירות יתירה ביותר ולחפש בעצמו אם לא נאחז בו עי"ז אחיזה היצה"ר שהוא בחי' טומאת הנדה כנ"ל. וע"פ דרך זה דעת לנבון נקל לבאר עוד דינים והלכות הרבה שבענין זה:
aligned_segments.en: And see in the book of Ta'amei HaMitzvos and you will understand further for our subject.

aligned_segments.he: סימן ר"א

הלכות מקואות. עיי"ש חילוקי דינים הרבה בין מעיין למקוהשל מי גשמים וכיוצא והכל מובן קצת ע"פ הנ"ל. כי מעיין הוא מבחי' החכמה העליונה כידוע. וע"כ מטהר אף בזוחלין. כי הוא בבחי' נחל נובע מקור חכמה שממנו הולך האור ומתפשט לכל המדריגות בבחינת יפוצו מעינותיך חוצה. ועל כן יכולים להתקרב להשי"ת ע"י כל דבר שבעולם ע"י השכל שמאיר להאדם. כי הוא בבחי' הולך ואור עד נכון היום שזהבחינת זוחלין שהמים הולכים ונזחלים גם ברחוק ממקום נביעתם. אבל מקוה היא בבחי' מלכות דלית לה מגרמה כלום רק מה שמשפיעים בה מבחי' ומדריגו' דקדושה שלמעלה מבחינתה שזה בחינת מי הגשמםי וכיוצא שמתכנסין ומתקבצין לתוך המקוה והוא רק בחי' מדה וצמצום לקבל האור והחיות על ידה. וע"כ אינה מטהרת אלא באשבורן שיהיו המים שבתוכה מכונסים ומקובצים כי היא מבחי' זאת.
aligned_segments.en: [§5] And therefore one is careful especially regarding the sanctity of thought — not to cast his eyes at that time upon another cup — and everything should be with will and love and affection and settled and composed mind and great modesty — all so that the union should be in complete holiness as is fitting — and they merit through this to draw holy souls to their children from the root of the holiness of the supreme holy union — as stated.

aligned_segments.he: (עיין מאורי אור) ויש עוד לבאר בזה הרבה ומובן ממילא קצת להמעיין
aligned_segments.en:
סִימָן פ״ד

[§1]
The laws of insects. And this is the aspect of the impurity of the eight creeping creatures mentioned in the Torah — which are the weasel, the mouse — etc. — and it is cited in the writings that they correspond to the aspects of the roots of the klippos mixed in the dross of the eight kings of Edom — etc. And regarding our subject: for they are from the sitra achra of Esav — who is Edom — who grows strong essentially to separate a person from holy Chochmah — the aspect of ches. And therefore correspondingly they too are eight [ches]. And holy Chochmah is the aspect of holiness. And they are completely impure — the opposite of the aspect of holiness. And therefore their impurity is as a lentil — which is the aspect of what was the beginning of Esav's wickedness — and the despising of the birthright — which is the aspect of holy Chochmah — was for the sake of a lentil stew — as is explained in the parashah. And this is also the aspect of the prohibition of: "all the creeping creature that creeps upon the earth" — and the Torah calls them sheketz [abomination] — etc. — for they are of very low levels — the very opposite of the aspect of holy life-force — which is the aspect of ches and nun — the aspects of grace and beauty and splendor — and they are disgusting and repulsive. Therefore: "you shall not make your souls abominable through animal or through bird" — and similarly regarding the impure species of water — it is said of them: sheketz — for all of them are from the aspect of the sitra achra — which is disgusting and abominable — the aspect of what our Sages taught: "if that villain encounters you — etc." — the aspect of what is said [Yirmiyahu 49] about Edom: "contemptible among men." And therefore they make the souls of those who eat them abominable.

[§2]
And therefore they are forbidden only if the insects grew while still attached [to the ground] — which is called "the creeping creature that creeps upon the earth." But those that form in something detached are not forbidden unless they separated — for the essential distinction between a human being and an animal is: the spirit of the human ascends upward — and the spirit of the animal descends downward to the earth — and therefore it is greatly addicted to physicality and earthliness — and has no daas or intellect. And therefore: insects that creep literally on the earth — and all their growth is close to the actual earth — they are therefore very weak and of very little life-force. And as our Sages taught: any creature that has no bone does not survive twelve months. And therefore all of them are forbidden. And likewise water insects that spring up while attached — or at least flow — etc. — as explained in the Shulchan Aruch. But those in water in vessels — and likewise those in fruits — those that formed in something detached — are not in the category of "the creeping creature that creeps on the earth" — unless they separated. For then the spirit of impurity — wandering the earth — from the aspect of the sitra achra of Esav — has already seized them. And the general rule: those insects that formed while attached are from the aspect of the sitra achra — the aspect of Esav — of whom it is said: "the wicked are estranged from the womb" [Tehillim 58:4]. And therefore they are forbidden immediately. But those waters or fruits that were detached from their place of attachment in purity and fitness — and had no insects in them at that time — and were fit then for Israel's food without any checking at all — therefore: if insects formed in them afterwards — they are permitted as long as they have not separated. For they are in the aspect of: "He has not looked upon iniquity in Yaakov" — as stated — since they are included in the permitted food and have not separated and distinguished themselves from it at all — the name of prohibition has not fallen upon them. (And even if they separated — in a place of rabbinic lenience — see in the Shulchan Aruch the particulars.) But if they separated from the produce or food and became a matter in their own right — the sitra achra has already found a place to fall upon them — and then even if they return — they are forbidden. And from this some small allusions are also understood regarding a person's service.

aligned_segments.he: סימן ר"ג וכו'

הלכות נדרים. כי כשרואה אדגם שיצרו תקפו וכו' אזי מצוה לישבע ולנדור כדי לזרז עצמו כמו שארו"ל כי עי"ז נותן כח לבחי' מלכות דק' להתגבר על מלכות דסט"א בחי' היצה"ר בחי' עשו. כי ארז"ל הנודר כאלו הוא נודר בחיי המלך שזה בחי' חכמה בחינת החכמה תחיה כנ"ל.
aligned_segments.en: [§6] And even when the union is not for the sake of offspring — such as for the aged or a nursing mother — etc. — one must also be careful in all these matters — so as not to damage, G-d forbid, the supreme holy union — as it were.

aligned_segments.he: והנשבע כאילו נשבע במלך עצמו שהוא בחי' זעיר אנפין בחי' התורה וכמובן ג"כ בזוה"ק ובכתבים.
aligned_segments.en:
סִימָן פ״ה

[§1]
The signs of locusts: all that has four legs and four wings — and its wings cover the majority of its body — etc. — and it has two jumping legs. For from all of this it is apparent that its power of movement is greatest — to flee from enemies — and also its wings cover the majority of its body like a shield and armor — as stated — and also its power of flight is very great.

aligned_segments.he: וע"י בחינת החכמה והתורה הק' נותן כח להיצר טוב בחי' המלכות דקדושה להתגבר כנגד מלכות דסטו"א.
aligned_segments.en: And not only that — but it also has jumping legs — to leap and spring above the physicality of the earthly place.

aligned_segments.he: וע"כ יעקב אבינו שזכה לבחי' החמכה והשכל דקדושההיה ראש לנודרים כ"ש וידר יעקב נדר וכמו שארז,ל.
aligned_segments.en: And all of these are signs of its purity.

aligned_segments.he: ועל כן ארז,ל (במ"ר פ' וישלח) שכשאיחר יעקב נדרו אמר לו הקב"ה יעקב שכתחת נדרך קום עלה וכו' ואם אין אתה עושה כן הרי אתה כעשו מה עשו נודר ואינו מקיים וכו' וע,כ נודרין בעת צרה כי כל הצרות והיסורין נמשכין מבחי' פגם ומיעוט הירח בחי' המלכות ח"ו וע"י נדר מתקנין זאת כנ"ל. וזה שארז"ל אל תהי רגיל בנדרים כי אף על פי שהנדרים הם בבחי' לעולם ירגיז אדם יצ"ט על יצה"ר כי מאחר שרואה שיצרו מתנכל עליו להכשילו ח"ו ע"כ הוא גודר בפניו ונודר לפרוש עצמו גם מהיתר שזה בחי' נדרים סיג לפרישות.
aligned_segments.en: And even so: a tradition is required that its name is chagav — a pure species — for the sitra achra also sometimes makes use of and dresses itself in these aspects.

aligned_segments.he: וכברנתבאר שעי"ז בעצמו יש לו כח להתגבר על יצרו אעפ"כ לפעמים אומרים לו לא דיך מה שאסרה תורה וכו' כי לפעמים מתגרה בו יצרו על ידי זה ביותר עד שמביאו לעבור על נדרו ח"ו ולפעמים זה בעצמו הוא מעצת היצר שדרכו להתלבש במצוות בתחלה וכמבואר במאמר הנ"ל וכמו כן לענין זה שמתחלה מסיתו לעשות מצוה ולנדור ועיקר כוונתו בכדי להכשילו אח"כ לעבור על נדרו וע,כ הזהיר הכתוב ע"ז הרבהו אמר טוב אשר לא תדור משתדור ולא תשלם דלכאורה קשה פשיטא ומאי קמשמע לן אלא דר"ל שצריך להתבונן על דרכיו מאד קודם שידור כי אולי זה גופו מעצת יצרו כנ"ל.
aligned_segments.en: And specifically because it is so light of movement — even so: since there are also impure species among them — the error and exchange and transposition are very common — and therefore a tradition is specifically required.

aligned_segments.he: וע"כאין הנדר חל עד שיוציא בשפתיו ויהיו פיו ולבו שוין כי הדיבור הוא מבחי' מלכות פה וע"י הנדר נותנין כח לבחי' המלכות דק' ע,י שממשיכיןלה אור המוחין העליונים שזה בחי' פיו ולבו שוין בחי' והיתה אור הלבנה כאור החמה המבפ"נ. וע"כ הולכין בנדרים אחר כוונת הנודר שהיא מבחי' החכמה והמוחין שהם עיקר שורש הנדר כנ"ל.
aligned_segments.en: And therefore the pure ones require no shechitah — for the majority of them is from the finest elements — and the minority from the element of earth.

aligned_segments.he: רכ"ח וכו') וע,כ התרת נדרים הוא ע"י חכם דגמיל וסביר. היינ ושזכה לעסק התורה בחי' דגמיר בחי' ליגמר אינש וכו' וגם סביר שהוא בעל סברא ובעל שכל שהוא מבחי' החכמה והשכל העליון הנ"ל וכן יכולין להתיר נדר תלתא דגמירי להו וסברי. שיכוליטון עכ"פ לקבל הארת השכל קצת וכיון שהם שלשה מאיר בהם בחי' אור קדושת יעקב אבינו ע"ה שכלול מכל השלשה אבות בחי' יעקב חבל נחלתו כמו שדרז"ל ועל כן יכולים להתיר הנדר ששם שרשו כנ"ל. וע"כ היתר נדרים הוא ע"י חרטה שמתחרט בעיקר הנדר מתחלתו ומשרשו ועל כן יכול החכם או השלשה הנ"ל לעלות לשרשו שהוא בבחי' חכמה ולהתירו. ואם אינו מתחרט מעקרו צריכין לבקש לו פתח וכו' והפתח הוא ג,כ מבחי' חכמה בחי' בחכמה פותח שערים וגם כי בחי' ספירת החכמה הוא בניקוד פתח כידוע. וע"כ אין פותחין לו בנולד כי מאחר שעיקר ההתרה הוא ע"י אור החכמה וארז"ל איזהו חכם הרואה את הנולד וע"כ א"א להתיר לו ע"י שלא ראה את הנולד שזה ההיפך מבחי' חכמה כי אז אינו מתחרט אלא מן הנולד ואילך ולא מעיקרו (ועיין פנים בש"ע בזה)
aligned_segments.en: [§7] And therefore our Sages cautioned that the bed should be placed between north and south — alluding to the two aspects mentioned above: the table in the north — corresponding to the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of the table of kings — the royal crown — as is known — and the Menorah — alluding to Torah and holy Chochmah — which is the essential light — as stated.

aligned_segments.he: סימן ר"מ וכו'
הלכות כיבוד אב ואם.
aligned_segments.en:
סִימָן פ״ו

[§1]
The signs of eggs — to recognize whether they are from pure fowl: if both its heads are round or both are pointed — or if the yolk was on the outside and the white on the inside — it is known to be the egg of an impure bird — etc.

[§2]
For a pointed head alludes to the sharpening of the mochin — the aspect of the light of supernal Chochmah — the aspect of what is said [Iyov 41:22]: "beneath him are sharp pieces of pottery" — Rashi explains: rays of the sun — which is the aspect of the light of Chochmah.

aligned_segments.he: עיין זוהר ויקרא דף י"ב כתיב כבד את אביך ואת אמך וכתיב במעשה בראשית יהיה מאורות וכו' אלין מאורות דא סיהרא ואין שמשא אלא קוב "ה וכו' ולית סיהרא אלא כנסת ישראל וכו' מבואר לעינינו כי אדם לא נברא אלא לכבודו ית' היינו להכיר ולידע רותו ית' ולהתקרב אליו ית' וזהזוכין ע"י בחי' אור השכל שהוא בחי' שמש ובחי' אב בחכמה וע,י בחי' מלכות בחינת כנסת ישראל בחינת אם ובחי' לבנה.
aligned_segments.en: And likewise: [Mishlei 27:17]: "and a man sharpens the face of his fellow" — Rashi explains: referring to Torah scholars who sharpen each other. And a round head alludes to the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of a circle — the aspect of: "and the head is round toward the throne from behind" — and as cited in the discourse Heichal HaKodesh, Siman 59.

aligned_segments.he: וע"כ צריך לכבד בגשמיות ג"כ את אביו ואת אמו שבא על ידם לעוה"ז ומסתמא מאת ה' צבאות היתה זאת כי נשמתו צריכה לבא לזה העולם על ידם דייקא ושיזכה עי"ז לבא לתכליתו הנצחי להתקרב אליו ית'.
aligned_segments.en: And it is known: the sitra achra begins in connection and ends in separation — the aspect of: "then all evildoers shall be scattered" [Tehillim 92:10]. And therefore: if both its heads are round — it alludes to it being from the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra.

aligned_segments.he: וגם יש להם חלק בענין המשכת המוחין שלו כי מוח הבן ממוח האב וכמוב ןמזה בכתבים ג"כ וע"כ צריך לכבדם בבחי' כבוד חכמים ינחלו וע"כ נסמך כבוד אצל אב שהוא בחינת אב בחכמה ואצל המורא הקדים האם כ"ש איש אמו ואביו תיראו כי היא בבחינת מלכות בבחי' יראה וזה בחי' גודל זהירות כיבוד אב של עשו כמו שארז"ל כי רצה להתגבר עי"ז דייקא על יעקב שהוא בחי' השכל דקדושה, וע,כ באמת וירא יעקב מאד ואמר תאמר שהוא בא אלי מכח כיבוד אב ואם כמו שארז"ל (במ"ר פ' וישלח) היינו כנ"ל אבל באמת כ"ז לא היה אלא לפנים ולרמות את אביו אבל בלבו היה בהיפוך ממש מכל הנ"ל כמו שמצינו בפירוש שאמר יקרבו ימי אבל אבי וכמו שארז"ל ונאמר עליו יזכר עון אבותיו וכו' כשארז"ל.
aligned_segments.en:
And likewise: if both its heads are pointed — it alludes to it being from the aspect of the male — the aspect of the intellect of the sitra achra.

[§3]
And therefore: even a pure egg — whose one head is round and one head is pointed — one does not rely on it until asking the hunter — etc. — for in holiness there is a complete and holy union between male and female — which are the aspects of Chochmah and Malchus. And therefore the essential binding of the egg is in its pointed head — where the drop of the male bird binds — as explained in the Beis Yosef, Siman 66, in the name of most authorities — see there.

aligned_segments.he: וגם כי עיקר כיבוד אב ואם הוא שיהיה שמם מתכבד ומתייקר על ידו ע,י שהוא צדיק ובעל מעשים טובים.
aligned_segments.en: And this: for this very pointed head is also in the aspect of the male — as stated. And according to the opinion that holds the binding is in the round head — this too can be explained according to the matter above — as is self-evident.

aligned_segments.he: שזה עיקר כבודם לעד וכשארז"ל אבל לא ע"י רשע עריץ כעשו שאדרבא היה לקלון ולחרפה להם ועיקר כבודם היה רק שכיבדם בדברים גשמיים אבל בדברים רוחנים הנוגעים לעבודת ה' שזההיה כל חפצם של יצחק ורבקה בזה היה אדרבא למורת רוח להם כמבואר במקרא להדיא.
aligned_segments.en: And therefore: if the yolk is on the outside and the white is on the inside — this too is a sign that it is from an impure bird. For the white — which is white — is from the aspect of the male — the aspect of: "a man who emits white" — etc. — and the yolk is from the aspect of the female.

aligned_segments.he: וע,כ ארז,ל בתדא"ר פ' כ"ו שהמקיים מצוות כיבוד אב ואם כראוי אין שום חטא בא על ידו היינו כנ"ל.
aligned_segments.en: And in the sitra achra — the female rules over the male — as explained in the holy Zohar regarding yoter al hakaved [the lobe of the liver] — and likewise regarding pitora asher al ha-nahar [the table that is on the river]. But even if one head is round and one pointed — and the white is on the outside and the yolk inside — even so it is possible that it is the egg of an impure bird.

aligned_segments.he: כי מאחר שנותן עי"ז כח ביותר למלכות דקדושה בחי' היצ"ט להתגבר על בחי' מלכו תדסט,א קליפת עשו בחי' היצה,ר ע,כ ממילא ניצול עי"ז מכל חטאים.
aligned_segments.en: For falsehood does not endure unless there is some truth at its beginning. And likewise: the sitra achra also begins in connection — from which flows the fact that the yetzer hara first dresses itself in mitzvos — for they mimic like a monkey before a man.

aligned_segments.he: ומחת שעיקר בחי' תיקון המלכות שעי"ז זוכין לאור המוחין הוא רק ע"י עסק התורה כנ"ל ע"כ ארז,ל שתלמוד תורה גדול מכיבוד אב ואם:
aligned_segments.en:
Therefore one does not rely on these signs until asking the hunter — etc. — as explained in the Shulchan Aruch. Nachas HaShulchan — Part VII (Yoreh Deah) · Segment 2 · Simanim 30–87

Nachas HaShulchan — Part VII
Yoreh Deah · Segment 3 · Simanim 87–178

Basar b'Chalav · Taaruvos · Foods of Non-Jews · Avodah Zarah · Ribbis · Kilayim

By Rabbi Nachman of Tchehrin ז״ל

✦ ✦ ✦

aligned_segments.he: סימן רמ"ב וכו'
הלכו תכבוד רבו ותלמידי חכמים חייב אדם בכבוד רבו ויראתו יותר מבשל אביו.
aligned_segments.en: [§8] And therefore the whispered formula recited at the time of union — "Atifah b'kitfah" — etc. — was instituted in order to separate the sitra achra and the yetzer hara from having any hold in the union — for at times the yetzer hara clothes himself in mitzvos — as explained within — especially in this matter — which truly is a mitzvah — but when the yetzer hara incites one improperly or leads one to some damage or forbidden act — G-d forbid — it is the aspect of a mitzvah brought through transgression — and therefore one must be careful to banish him.

aligned_segments.he: היינו כי אביו ואמו הם בבחי' סיבות רחוקות להמשכת התיקונים הנ"ל כנגד רבו שהוא בבחי' סיבה קרובה לזה.
aligned_segments.en:
סִימָן פ״ז וְכוּ׳ — בָּשָׂר בְּחָלָב

[§1]
The laws of basar b'chalav [meat with milk] — etc. It is explained in the holy Zohar [Mishpatim 125] that through basar b'chalav one gives strength to the sitra achra to suckle from holiness — G-d forbid — etc. — see there. And from this it is self-evident that then the sitra achra has even more power to overpower. And also: through this it has more power to dress itself in mitzvos and deceive the person — and through this one becomes separated and distanced from holy wisdom and intellect and life-force — which is the essential aspect of the tzelem Elokim [Divine Image] that illuminates the face of man — the aspect of: "a man's wisdom illuminates his face" — as explained in Siman 57. And therefore it is explained in the holy Zohar there: that through basar b'chalav the tzelem Elokim departs from him. And see in the Tikkunim, Tikkun 14 — where it is explained that the prohibition of basar b'chalav is in the aspect of: *"you shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together"* [Devarim 22:10]. And there in Tikkun 10 of the later Tikkunim it is explained: ox and donkey are the aspect of the klippos of Esav and Yishmael — which are the totality of the kingdoms of the sitra achra — as stated. And this: the prohibition of basar b'chalav is juxtaposed in Parshas Mishpatim and in Parshas Yisro to the mitzvah of bikkurim — for this mitzvah is from the side of the holiness of holy intellect and wisdom — the aspect of the birthright. And in Parshas Reeh this mitzvah is juxtaposed to the mitzvah of maaser — which is from the aspect of Malchus — as is known.

[§2]
For through basar b'chalav one damages the aspect of drawing these rectifications. And therefore: when the angels prosecuted against the receiving of the Torah — through which one merits the aspect of these rectifications — the Holy One, blessed be He, replied to them: "did you not eat meat with milk at Avraham's home?" — as stated. For through this one damages the aspect of drawing these rectifications. And therefore the Torah was strict regarding basar b'chalav only concerning the meat of cattle specifically — in which is the essential hold of the spirit of folly — the aspect of Esav — only that Israel rectify it through shechitah — etc. — as stated. And therefore it requires shechitah of both signs — and its blood does not require covering — and its fat is forbidden — as stated.

aligned_segments.he: כי ע,H שלומד עמו תורה עי"ז זוכה להמשיך התיקונים הנ"ל בשלימות וע"כ חייב בכבודו ויראתו כנגד שני הבחינות הנ,ל שהם בח'י חכמה ובחי' מלכות כנ"ל וע"כ החולק על רבו כחולק על השכינה וכו'.
aligned_segments.en:
But the meat of a chayah — in which the light of holy life-force shines more — therefore its fat is permitted — and its blood requires covering. And all the more so fowl — which requires only one sign — therefore there is no biblical prohibition of basar b'chalav with it. But even so it is also rabbinically forbidden.

[§3]
And therefore holy Torah expressed this prohibition in the language: "you shall not cook a kid in its mother's milk" — even though gedi [kid] includes all cattle. And this is because in the kid there is an extra hold for the aspect of Esav the hairy man. And therefore it is said of Yaakov: "and the skins of the kids of the goats she placed on his hands" — etc. — and it is said afterwards: "and he did not recognize him for his hands were like the hands of Esav his brother — hairy." And see in the holy Zohar what is explained regarding the kids of the goats — and why even so they are permitted for Israel's eating. And therefore the Torah alluded: since in the meat of cattle — the aspect of gedi — there is an extra hold for the aspect of Esav — but Israel rectify it through the mitzvos of shechitah and nikur [removal of forbidden fat and sinews] and salting — therefore: if one cooks it in cattle milk — which was drawn and clarified from its blood — in the aspect of the blood becoming congealed and becoming milk — and it became so clarified of itself through the supernal power coming upon it from above — whose root is from the aspect of supernal whiteness — the aspect of wisdom and thought — through which all holy clarifications — in the aspect of: kulhu b'machshavah isbariru [all are clarified through thought] — and from there the redness of the blood — in which the sitra achra of Esav the red one has seized — was sweetened until it was turned into whiteness — the whiteness of milk — until it became permitted for Israel's eating without any rectification at all. And this is the aspect of: *"and enough milk of goats for your bread — etc. — and life for your maidens"* [Mishlei 27:27] — for it is from the aspect of wisdom and life — as stated.

[§4]
Therefore: if one cooks in it meat of cattle — in which the sitra achra of Esav has greatly seized — through this one gives it room to overpower even more — G-d forbid. And therefore the Torah was strict specifically in the manner of cooking — for through cooking the flavors of one and the other blend together even more — until they are completely included together and become one — and through this it has the power to suckle and overpower even more. And therefore the cooking itself is also forbidden. And its prohibition is so severe — to the point that it is also forbidden for any benefit — for even the benefit alone that the person receives from it greatly damages his soul — for through this the aspect of Esav — who is forbidden for all benefit — seizes upon him. For all the good of the wicked is evil for the righteous — as understood also regarding Yaakov our father when Esav said to him: "let me place" — etc. And therefore it only applies to the meat of a pure animal in pure milk — where both are permitted. And even meat of neveilah or forbidden fat — even so — at minimum they are of a permitted species.

[§5]
But if the meat or milk is of an impure species — then there is no prohibition of basar b'chalav regarding cooking and benefit — since it is forbidden anyway from the beginning of its creation — the sitra achra no longer has room to suckle from holiness through this.

aligned_segments.he: כי מאחר שהוא מביאו להכיר את בוראו ולהתקרב אליו ית' וע,כ כשפוגם בכבודו כאלו ח"ו פוגם בכבוד השכינה כביכול.
aligned_segments.en:
And therefore: fish and locusts — which require no shechitah at all — are permitted with milk — even rabbinically. But even so — biblically it is only forbidden through the manner of cooking — and specifically meat of cattle in cattle milk.

[§6]
Even so: our Sages forbade even placing cheese on the table together with meat — even meat of a chayah or fowl — since one may come to eat them together — and give the sitra achra a hold to seize. And not only that — but even if one has already eaten meat — one must not eat cheese afterwards — etc. — as explained in the Shulchan Aruch. For since the sitra achra has some hold in it — one must be concerned also regarding what one eats afterwards — since it draws its flavor even more — or there may remain some between the teeth. But if one ate the cheese first — one need not be concerned about what one eats meat afterwards — provided through rinsing and washing — and see in the Shulchan Aruch. And therefore: basar b'chalav does not apply biblically with the milk of a slaughtered or dead animal. For our Sages taught [Bechoros 6b] — regarding the permission of milk — it is an innovation [chiddush] — since it resembles a limb from a living animal yet the Torah permitted it. And therefore one may say: specifically with milk from a living animal — whose permission itself is an innovation — therefore if one cooks meat in it — the sitra achra is aroused to suckle from this — as stated. But not so with the milk of a slaughtered animal — whose permission is not such an innovation. And likewise with milk of a dead animal — which has departed from the prohibition of a limb from a living animal — and even though it is now forbidden because of neveilah — it is in truth forbidden — and the sitra achra has no room to suckle from this. And even according to those who hold that milk of neveilah has no biblical prohibition of neveilah — one may say they hold: even so the prohibition of a limb from a living animal has departed from it — and therefore it is not such an innovation — since it is milk of a dead animal. (And see this matter in the legal authorities.) But even so: even with the milk of a slaughtered animal — it is rabbinically forbidden. And see Siman 30 regarding the law of kechal [udder].
