נתנה רשות לרופא לרפאות. כי הגם שעיקר הרפואה הוא ע"י התורה בבחי' כל בשרו מרפא. כי התורה נותנת כח לבחי' מללכות ומתקנת כל הפגמים ועי"ז בא רפואה. אעפ"כ לאו כל אדם זוכה שיתקן כ"כ עד שיקבל רפואתו ע"י דבר ה' בעצמו בבחי' אמר ה' ורפאתיו בלי שום השתדלות ברפואות כלל. ע,כ המשיכה התורה המתקה כזו עד שלפעמים יכולים לקבל רפואה ע, ירפואות גשמיות אע"פ שלא נתתקן הכל ברחניות עדיין בשלימות אך אזצרכין להתגבר עוד ביותר בתפלה זשיזימין לו השי"ת רפואתו ע"י איש פלוני וסם פלוני וכו' כשארז"ל ועין בזהליקות"נ סי' ג' ועיין שם גם בסי' י"ז מענין השגחה וטבע והיו צריכין להרחיב הביאור בזה כי בענן זה של השתדלות ברפואות יש מבוכה גדולה בזה גם בין הראשונים ז"ל ויש בענין זה דברים עמוקים הרבה כמובן בדבריו ז"ל בכחמה מקומות ועיין זוה"ק ח"ג דף רצ"ט מעשה מרופא אחד ושם מובן שענין משכיל אל דל קאי גם על הרופא שמשתדל ברפואתו של החולה. וע,כ ארז"ל מי שיש לו חולה בתוך ביתו ילך אצל חכם ויבקש עליו רחמים. כי החכם תפלתו מקובלת בבחי' דברי חכמים בנחת נשמעים המבבפ"נ. וע"כ יכול להמשיך לו רפואה וחיים ע,י תפלתו מאור החכמה העליונה. וזה שואמרין לחולה כשנוטה למות ח"ו התודה וכו' ובשכר שאתה מתודה אתה חי וכל המתודה יש לו חלק בעוה"ב וכו' כי זה עיקר מצוות הביקור חולים לפקח על דרכי החולה ולהשתדל בטובתו. וע,כ כשרואין שנוטה למות ח"ו ואז יש לחוש שלא תאה מיתתו בבחי' סיטרא דמותא ממש ח"ו שהיא מבחי' סטרא דעשו וכנ"ל ע"כ אומרין לו התודה כי ע"י התשובה והוידוי באמת עי"ז נסתלקין ממנו עונותיו שבאו מצד היצה,ר בחי' עשו וניתנין על ראשו של עשו בבחי' והתודה עליו וכו' ונשא השעיר עליו את כל עונותם וכו' ודרז"ל דקאי על עשו וזה נמשך גם ע,י כל וידוי שמתודה כל אדח מישראל על עונותיו וכמובן בזוה"ק ח"ב דף רס"ב ובפרט ע,י הוידוי שקודם הפטירה וע"כ בשכר שאתה מתודה אתה חי. כי עי"ז תינצל מסטרא דמותא בחי' עשו וימשך עליך אור החים ואם ח"ו ההכרת להסתלק תהא מיתתו עצמה בבחי' חים בבחי' צדיקים במיתתם נקראים חיים.ו זה וכל המתודה יש לו חלק לעוה"ב שש םעיקר החיים. וזהו שארז"ל שמצוה לעמוד על האדם בשעת פטירה שנאמר ויחי עוד לנצח וכו' כי יראה חכמים ימותו וכו'. כי גם הנפש של הנפטר משתוממת בשעה שיוצאת מן הגוף והיא יחידי. כי מאחר שהוא אצלה דבר חדש יוצא מן ההרגל ע"כ משתוממת שלא תפול לסטרא דמותא ממש מאחר שרואה שהחיים בדלו ממנו והוא נשאר בדד וע,כ יש לו נייח נפש ביותר כשרואה שגם אחר פטירתו הוא בין אנשים חיים מישראל קדושים אז אינו משתומם מפטירתו כ"כ כי יודע שמתתו בעצמה קשורה עם החיים אמיתיים בבי' והמתים להחיות. וע"כ הוא מצוה וזכייה גם להחיים העומדים אז. כי הם נתעוררין כפי בחינתם לחיות מעתה חיים חדשים חיים אמיתיים חיים נצחיים כי ע, ישרואים בעיניהם פטירת חבריהם עי"ז נשבר לבם בקרבם ונכנע יצרם הרע שהוא עיקר סטרא דמותא ביותר. כי הלא מכניעין אותו גם רק ע" ישמזכיירן לו יום המיתה מכ"ש כשרואים הדבר בעינים ממש וע,כ עי"ז דייקא זוכין לחיים בבחי' ויחי עוד לנצח וכו'. וזה כי יראה חכמים ימותו וכו' כי בשעת פטירת חכמים שהם חיים באמת גם לאחר מיתתן וע"כ נמשך אז הארה גדולה מאור החכמה העליונה שהיא עיקר אורהחיים כי באמת גם בגשמיות לעיני האדם ניכר אז ביותר מכלת החכם על הכסיל כמאמר הכתוב כי אין זכרון לחכם עם הכסיל וכו' וע"כ מסיים הכתוב גם כאן יחד כסיל ובער יאבדו וכו' שעי"ז ניכר ביותר מעלת החכמה וכו' כיתרון האור מ ןהחשך. וע"כ זוכה העומד שם לחיי נצחי וזה שארז"ל מת שאין לו מנחמים מתקבצים עשרה בני אדם לתוך ביתו.
aligned_segments.en:
סִימָן קי״ח וְכוּ׳

[§1]
And therefore: if one deposits or sends with a non-Jew — or a suspect — something with a biblical concern of prohibition — lest he exchange it — one needs a seal within a seal — corresponding to the aspect of these rectifications.

aligned_segments.he: וכן המנהג להתפלל ולעסוק בתורה בבית האבל כל שבעה. כי עי"ז יש לו נייח נפש מאד לנפש הנפטר כשהוא עדיין בי ןהחיים העוסקים בתורה ותפלה שהם עיקר החיים ואז יוכל להתיישב בנפשו ביותר שגם מיתתו הוא בבחי' חיים כנ"ל.
aligned_segments.en: For the mochin and wisdom are the aspect of a seal — the aspect of tefillin — the aspect of mochin — which are in the aspect of a seal — as is known.

aligned_segments.he: והפלא הגדול איך שהחיים והמות שהם שני הפכיים ממש והם כרוכים ומחוברים ומתדבקין יחד זה בזה הן במהותן והן באיכותן. במהותם.
aligned_segments.en: And likewise: Malchus is the aspect of a seal — as our Sages taught [Bereishis Rabbah, Parshas Vayeshev]: "your seal and your cord — your seal is Malchus" — etc. — see there.

aligned_segments.he: שאנו רואים שכל מה שהאדם חי עוד יום אחד ביותר הוא מתקרב מהלך יום זה ביותר אל יום מיתתו בבחי' כי הולך אדם לבית עולמו וכתיב ויום המות מיום הולדו וכמובא. וכן מה שניתוסף ביותר יום אחד מיום מיתתו הוא מתקרב ביותר אל יום עמדו בתחיה כמאמר והמתים להחיות.
aligned_segments.en: [§10] [(Author's note: See the book Yikara d'Shabbata which brings from the holy Zohar that on Shabbos Hashem Himself, as it were, receives the prayers of Israel.

aligned_segments.he: וכן גם עכשיו קודם התחיה אעפ"כ מסתמא מתתקן ועולה ביותר בכל פעם ומתקרב יותר אל אור החיים האמיתיים. וכמ וכן גם באיכותם. כי כל מה שהאדם שוכח ביותר ביום מיתתו הוא מתרחק ביותר מאור החיים עד שנקרא מת גם בחייטו כמו שדרז"ל על פסוק והמתיים אינם יודעים מאומה.
aligned_segments.en: And therefore our Sages taught: "good is a handful with quiet" — this is Shabbos — the aspect of "words spoken in quietness are heard" — as explained within.)]

aligned_segments.he: וכל מה שמשים לבו ביותר ליום מיתתו זוכה ביותר לחיים אמיתיים דקדושה עד שגם במיתתו נקרא חי.
aligned_segments.en:
סִימָן קיט וְכוּ׳ — הִלְכוֹת גִּיטִּין

[§1]
The laws of gittin [divorce]. It is written: *"if a man takes a woman"* [Devarim 24:1] — etc. — "and it shall be if she finds no favor in his eyes" — etc. — "and he shall write her a bill of severance" — etc. For the holy union — when it is complete — is in the aspect of chen — as stated. But when the union does not go well — and through this she finds no favor in his eyes — then he must write her a sefer [document] specifically. For sefer alludes to the aspect of Chochmah — as cited in the interpretation of Sefer Yetzirah on the matters of: sefer [book], sofer [scribe], and sippur [narrative] — and as cited in the holy Zohar. And likewise: holy Torah is called sefer. And likewise: the aspect of Malchus is called sefer — as is known. Therefore one must write her a bill of severance — and place it in her hand — and send her from his home. Meaning: just as the holy union was through these three aspects — through which Torah gives strength to holy Malchus — and through this Malchus — the aspect of nun — was connected and bound with the aspect of Chochmah — the aspect of ches — and receives life-force from it — as stated — so now: the separation and divorce between them is also not in the aspect of separation of the sitra achra entirely — G-d forbid. Rather: this separation too is according to holy Torah — and according to the drawing of these rectifications — the aspects of Chochmah and Malchus.

[§2]
And through this she is permitted to another man — to unite with him in the aspect of holy union. And this is the aspect of: "and she shall depart from his home and go and become the wife of another man." For the essential departure from his home — according to the bill of severance he gives her — according to the law of his holy Torah — is only for the sake of holy union — to unite with another man in complete holiness as is fitting. Only: the essential revelation of the matter of severance between them is through the sefer — the aspect of Torah. And this is the aspect of: "the document severs her" — etc.

aligned_segments.he: וע"כ האדם החי העומד בשעת פטירתו יוכל אז דייקא לקבל אור החיים בבחי' ויחי עוד לנצח וכו' כנ"ל ש"מ וכו') הלכו קריעה ואבלות ר"ל.
aligned_segments.en:
And therefore the one divorcing must be of sound mind — at the time of writing the get and giving it.

[§3]
Since the root of the entire matter is from the aspect of Chochmah — as stated. And this is the aspect of the three expressions of divorce written in the get: shavaktin [I have released you] — piturin [dismissal] — tiruchin [sending away]. For since this very separation is according to holy Torah — sometimes: if the woman is wicked and dissolute — it is a commandment to divorce her. And if she is not dissolute — then the separation is so that there be afterwards through this a complete holy union. It emerges: through these divorces one is separating and sending away the sitra achra and the yetzer hara — who wanted to take hold in this union. For since lo misdar lehu — and she found no favor in his eyes — and there is a division of hearts and hatred between them — automatically there is more of a hold of the sitra achra there — since they are in the aspect of the sitra d'piruda — as stated. Therefore: if it is impossible to make peace between them — such that their union be in love and brotherhood and companionship as befitting a holy union — then on the contrary: in such a union there is hold of the sitra achra — to the point that children born from this union are sometimes called children of hatred — G-d forbid. Therefore: the divorce — through which they fully separate from each other — is in the aspect of driving away the sitra achra and the yetzer hara — so that they have no portion and hold in the union of Israel.

[§4]
And regarding the matter of divorce and separation — there are three aspects — one after the other. And all three are encompassed under the heading of severance. For sometimes when she does not find favor in his eyes — he abandons her and distances himself from her in his heart — and through this she too distances herself from him — and separation arises between them. And this is encompassed under: shavaktin — that he abandoned her. And sometimes she does not separate from him until he actually divorces her from his home with complete divorce. And this is encompassed under: tiruchin. And these three aspects exist also in the matter of subduing the yetzer hara — which is also the aspect of divorce — as cited in the kavanos on the verse: "when he changed his behaviour before Avimelech — and he drove him away — and he departed" [Tehillim 34:1].

aligned_segments.he: כי כבר נתבאר שהלבושים והבגדים של ישראל מרמזין לבחינת המשכת התיקונים הנ,ל שהם בחי' חיים וע"כ כשנפטר אחד מישראל ובפרט קרוב ממשפחתו שהם סמוכים זהאל זה בשרשם ביותר ע"כ צריך לקרוע בגדיו.
aligned_segments.en:
For sometimes the yetzer hara separates from one only through abandoning and leaving it — and not listening to it — and through this it separates from one without any arguments or quarrels. And sometimes one must push it away with even more distancing — the aspect of piturin. And sometimes one must drive it away with even greater distancing — to the point of complete divorce — the aspect of tiruchin. And this too is the aspect of what Avraham our father said to Lot — who is the aspect of the yetzer hara — as cited in the holy Zohar: *"separate please from me"* [Bereishis 13:9] — etc. — "if to the right — I will go left — and if to the left — I will go right." Even if it tempts one sometimes — and dresses in the temptation of a mitzvah — the aspect of right — even so: one should not listen to it — since one has already understood its ultimate intention — and knows it is an enemy and foe — lurking against one — and rising against one — as is also understood in the holy Zohar on this matter.

[§5]
And since holy Torah — and likewise our Sages — greatly dislike the matter of quarrel and separation between a person and one's fellow — and especially between husband and wife — they therefore hinted to us through this: that even if sometimes it is unavoidably necessary to separate from each other — even so it is better to minimize quarrel and division of hearts as much as possible. And therefore they arranged first the expression shavaktin — and then piturin — and then tiruchin — according to the gradations — one after the other — as stated. For at first one must think: perhaps one will only need to separate from her through the aspect of shavaktin alone. And if not — then necessity demands the aspect of piturin. And if not — then necessity demands the aspect of tiruchin. Only: since it is impossible to arrange the order of the gradations with a fixed rule — for sometimes necessity demands immediately at the very beginning to distance her with somewhat greater distancing — therefore they subsequently arranged the expression u'pirtas first. And sometimes one needs immediately even more distancing — therefore they subsequently arranged further the expression tiruchin first. And in this matter too they took care to arrange according to the gradations — first putting the expression shavaktin — then putting piturin — and finally putting tiruchin — all according to the above. And to clarify the matter a bit more: for sometimes — if he is divorcing her because she is a wicked and dissolute woman — it is a commandment to divorce her — then one must immediately distance her through the aspect of divorce and tiruchin — the aspect of: "drive out the scorner — and strife will depart" [Mishlei 22:10]. And sometimes — if he is divorcing her only because she found no favor in his eyes — then it is a commandment to minimize the quarrel and division of hearts as much as possible — through the aspects of shavaktin and piturin mentioned.

[§6]
But also in this there are aspects — such that sometimes one immediately needs the aspect of piturin — or even tiruchin. And all according to the matter — as long as all one's actions and all one's intention are for the sake of Heaven.

aligned_segments.he: וע"כ מצוה להספיד את המת ולבכות ולהתאבל עליו כי עי"ז מעוררין ומזכירין את שבחיו ותורתו ועבודת ושזה עיקר החיים ובצל זכיותיו חיינו ג"כ כי כל ישרא לערבים זה בזה.
aligned_segments.en:
And likewise in the matter of the divorce of subduing the yetzer hara — there are also these aspects. For our Sages taught: the yetzer hara — a child and a woman — push away with the left and draw close with the right. But if the yetzer hara tempts one to actual transgression — G-d forbid — then one must divorce it immediately and push it away with both hands — the aspect of: "Hashem rebukes you — O Satan" [Zechariah 3:2] — etc. But also in the matter of the inclination's temptation regarding what is permitted — there are various aspects. For sometimes even this inclination must be distanced immediately and without delay — since one sees and understands that its intention is for evil — G-d forbid — and one cannot elaborate on these matters — and it is self-evident. And therefore one must draw out the vavs of shavaktin — piturin — tiruchin — and also the vav of v'tarkas.

[§7]
For the vav is generally the vav of connection. And also it is elaborated in the holy Zohar that vav is the aspect of life. Therefore: even in these words — the essential words of severance and divorce — they allude that this is not a complete separation — the aspect of the sitra achra — the sitra d'piruda — the sitra d'mosa — G-d forbid. For death separates — etc. Rather: the essential purpose of this separation is for the sake of the complete union that will come through this afterwards — the aspect of Chochmah — the aspect of life — the aspect of: "there is no get after death." And this is the aspect of the large vavs in the get — which allude to the aspect of connection and life and peace — as stated. And also: it is elaborated in the discourse Ashrei mentioned — that holy Torah is the aspect of vav. And through it all the drawing of these rectifications — which are hinted at in the holy divorce mentioned. And this: one must be careful about the leg of the Heh of l'mehaich [to walk] — that one distances it from its roof. And likewise in all the Hehs.

aligned_segments.he: וכשאחד מהם עוסק בתורה ועבודת ה' הוא ממשיך קדושה וחיים גם לכל ישראל ועכשיו אבדנו אותו ועי"ז ההספד נתעור ביותר הרשימו של אור חכמתו וחיותו לעלות למקומו הרמתה ולהאיר משם גם לעוה"ז.
aligned_segments.en:
For since the divorce is in the aspect of driving away the sitra achra and the yetzer hara — who wanted to take hold in this union — the aspect of: "rebuking the serpent of the reed" — for one rebukes the sitra achra — and makes from ches a Heh — as elaborated in the holy Zohar and in the discourse b'Chatzotzerot, Siman Heh. For corresponding to holy Chochmah — the aspect of ches — as stated — there is the aspect of the ches of the sitra achra — the aspect of the daughters of Ches — as is known. For there is the aspect of holy life-force — and corresponding to it — the aspect of the life-force of the sitra achra — which is worse than death — the aspect of: "one who wishes to die — shall live." And this is the aspect of the wicked woman — who is worse than death. Therefore one must divorce this aspect — and separate the attached — and make from ches a Heh. And this is why one must be precise about the Hehs of the get — especially that of l'mehaich — that it not appear as l'machach — the language of mockery and laughter — the aspect of the sitra achra and the yetzer hara — the aspect of: "laughter is foolishness" — and as it is written: "as laughter is to the fool — to do lewdness" [Mishlei 10:23]. The aspect of the life-force of the sitra achra — who make all their days as festivals — and spend their days in laughter and frivolity. And lives such as these are worse than death — for they are from the aspect of the wicked woman — the sitra achra — of whom it is said: "she laughs at them with wealth in this world — and afterwards kills them". (And see the discourse Tzivisa Tzedek, Siman 23.) And therefore one must be particularly precise about this Heh. And therefore the get concludes: "according to the law of Moshe and Israel."

[§8]
For the essential matter of this separation — which is to divorce the sitra achra and the yetzer hara literally — if she is a wicked and dissolute woman whom it is a commandment to divorce — and also if this is not the case — only that lo misdar lehu — and she found no favor in his eyes — and this itself is from the aspect of the hold of the yetzer hara and the sitra achra — who provoke between them — until they are compelled to come to complete divorce and separation — so that both may afterwards merit holy union through these divorces. But all of this happens only through the power of holy Torah — through which the yetzer hara is subdued — and strength given to holy Malchus — as stated. And this is something that commonly happens many times — that there are quarrels and strife between a couple — until they come to divorce. And afterwards they take each other back — and there is peace between them forever. And this is because the sitra achra has already been divorced from taking hold and provoking between them — through the get and the divorce that was between them. And therefore the get must be before fit witnesses — the aspect of: "the testimony of Hashem is faithful — it makes wise the simple" — as elaborated above.

aligned_segments.he: וע,כ זוכין עי"ז מתאבלין עליו ומספידים אותו לחיים ואריכות ימים כמובן מדברי רז"ל.
aligned_segments.en:
Not only that — the custom is that the get be before ten Jews — for: "when ten are present — the Shechinah rests there." And therefore the sitra achra — the sitra d'piruda — cannot suckle from this — since everything is done according to holy Torah — and for the sake of the peace of holy union — of which it is said: "if they merited — the Shechinah dwells among them."

[§9]
And therefore the writing and signing of the get must be for the sake of the man divorcing and for the sake of the woman being divorced — in order to separate them through this at their root — where is the root of his name and her name — the aspect of: "living soul — that is his name." And this itself is the aspect of the writing and signing — (as cited in the Tikkunim, Tikkun 18): "the writing hand — this is the written Torah" (whose root is in Chochmah) — "the signing hand — this is the Oral Torah" (the aspect of Malchus-of-mouth — and it is called the Oral Torah). And therefore the scribe must also say before him that he is writing for her sake — etc. — and likewise the witnesses. For thought and speech are also in the aspect of Chochmah and Malchus — as is known. And therefore one writes in the get twelve lines — corresponding to twelve months — twelve tribes — upon which holy Malchus stands — as elaborated in the holy Zohar and in his teachings. And therefore all the lines in the get must be equal. For this is the essential fullness — that all twelve tribes be encompassed in one unity — so that the kingdom of the sitra achra — the sitra d'piruda — have no power to dominate them — as our Sages taught about: "the joining of the idols — Efraim — let it be" [Hoshea 4:17]. And then the holiness of the drawing of holy Malchus — the Heavenly Kingdom — shines in its fullness over them. The aspect of what the tribes said: "Hear O Israel" — etc. — "Hashem is One" — as our Sages taught. And this: *"and in Yeshurun there was a King — when the heads of the people were gathered — together the tribes of Israel"* [Devarim 33:5] — as stated.

[§1] For the holiness of Shabbos was given only to Israel and not to non-Jews — as it is written: *"between Me and the children of Israel"* [Shemos 31:17] — and as our Sages taught: "A non-Jew who rests on Shabbos is liable to death." And our Sages taught [Bereishis Rabbah, Shemos]: a parable of a king and his matron sitting facing one another — etc. — for during the weekdays — which are the days of labor — and labor is performed in order to clarify and elevate the holy sparks from within the sitra achra — therefore [the sitra achra] has some hold and connection with the aspect of holy Malchus — in the aspect of: "this is Jerusalem which I have set in the midst of the nations" [Yechezkel 5:5] — for she must descend among them to clarify from them the holy sparks. But on Shabbos the Shechinah rests, as it were — and "when Shabbos enters she is unified and separated from the other side" [Zohar] — and "all the dominions of anger flee and depart from her and there is no dominion elsewhere in all the worlds" [ibid.]. Therefore no labor is permitted on Shabbos — and even upon the thought of labor our Sages cautioned: "cease from the thought of labor."

סִימָן ק״כ

[§1]
And therefore: eating vessels of non-Jews made of metal require immersion. For the body of the food and the meal — through which is man's life-force — is in the aspect of wisdom. And the vessel in which one eats is in the aspect of Malchus. And therefore: eating vessels — even new ones — since they were in the possession of non-Jews and were prepared for the meals of non-Jews — the spirit of impurity — from the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — rests upon them.

aligned_segments.he: וזה בחי' הז' ימי אבילו וכל הדברים הנוהגים בהם.
aligned_segments.en:
And the root of this is from the aspect of sospisa d'dahava [the dross of gold] — the aspect of the extension of gevuros — which are the aspect of fire — the aspect of metal vessels that are made through being melted in fire. And therefore: when one brings them into the possession of Israel — they require immersion in water — whose root is from the aspect of chasadim — the aspect of wisdom — the aspect of Torah. And through all of this the gevuros are sweetened at their root — and the aspect of the spirit of folly — spirit of impurity — is nullified — and the vessel rises from impurity to purity.

[§2]
And therefore: if one borrowed or rented a vessel from a non-Jew — immersion is not required. For it is still under the owner's authority — and also: it does not overpower as much — since it has not yet left the possession of the non-Jew — and is destined to return there. But when it leaves the possession of the non-Jew to the possession of Israel — then it overpowers more to suckle from the holiness — and therefore immersion is required.

[§3]
And therefore: old vessels of non-Jews — immersion is not sufficient — but as was their use — so must they be kashered. In the aspect of: *"all that comes into fire — pass it through fire"* [Bamidbar 31:23]. For since the vessel absorbed from the forbidden food itself — which is from the aspect of the sitra achra — therefore: if it absorbed through fire — it specifically requires libun [burning out] through fire. And if it absorbed through boiling water — it requires hag'alah [boiling out]. And if it absorbed while cold — washing and rinsing suffices. And this has been somewhat explained in Orach Chaim. And the matter of nosen ta'am lifgam [gives a spoiled taste] — and a vessel that is not a ben yomo — is somewhat explained above.

[§2] And therefore we separate from non-Jews on Shabbos in the most complete separation — for "then all who work iniquity will be separated" [Tehillim 92:10] — and therefore even instructing a non-Jew to perform a prohibited act on Shabbos — amirah l'akum — is [rabbinically] forbidden. For since the non-Jew does the labor on the intention and thought of the Jew — it is as if the Jew performed the labor — and this would give yet more power to the sitra d'mosa — and therefore the Torah says mechaleleha mos yumas [one who desecrates it shall die] — and even via a non-Jew through rabbinic decree it is forbidden — and even maras ayin [the appearance of wrongdoing] is a concern in this context — for the osos [signs] of Shabbos — שִׁין בַּת — allude to the aspects of shemen [oil] and pessilah [wick] — the aspects of Chochmah and Malchus — and the eyes [ayin] — the aspect of the beholder — correspond to the three colors of the eye which are the aspect of the three holy mochin. But if the non-Jew acts entirely on his own account and in a manner that involves no maras ayin — it is permitted.

סִימָן קכ״ג וְכוּ׳

[§1]
And therefore: the prohibition of drinking the wine of non-Jews is very severe — and even through their mere touch it becomes forbidden.

aligned_segments.he: ומבואר בכוונות שכל זה מחמת בתחי' הסתלקות המוחין שנמשך אז ע,י שנפטר נפש אחד מישראל.
aligned_segments.en:
For since in holiness its root is very lofty — and encompasses all the aspects of these rectifications. For it is from the aspect of wisdom and mochin — the aspect of: "wine and fragrance open the mind" — and the aspect of Torah — and the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of: "and the wine of the kingdom was abundant" [Esther 1:7] — etc. — as understood in the discourse Tehillah L'Dovid, Siman 12 — and likewise in the holy Zohar. And this is the aspect of: "he who merits — becomes a head." And therefore one must truly be very careful in its drinking — not to exceed the measure — G-d forbid — for intoxicating wine is the aspect of the very opposite of all the above. And therefore: it becomes forbidden through the touch of a non-Jew — and damages the soul of the Jew who drinks it — and the yetzer hara overpowers him even more — until one can come through this to all evil — G-d forbid. And this is the aspect of: "and concerning their wine — on account of their daughters." And see in the book Yayin HaMeshomar [The Preserved Wine] — which elaborated greatly on the severity of the prohibition — and you will understand from there for our subject. And according to the above you will understand how to explain many verses and teachings of our Sages that speak of wine in praise — or the opposite — and all of it is understood according to the above.

[§3] And likewise what is explained in Siman 246 regarding the resting of one's animal — for a Jew's animal also alludes to [that spiritual dimension] — as understood somewhat from what was explained above regarding *"You save man and beast alike, Hashem"* [Tehillim 36:7] — for behemah [animal] alludes to the aspect of Malchus — and therefore one is commanded regarding its resting — as it is written: *"you shall not perform any labor — you — etc. — and your animal"* [Shemos 20:10].

סִימָן קל״ה — קְרִיאַת הַתּוֹרָה

 

 
 [§1]
 And therefore one reads in the Torah during prayer — 
 for the essential acceptance of prayer is through the Torah, 
 through which one gives strength to the holy Malchus — 
 the aspect of the yetzer tov — 
 to overpower the kingdom of the sitra achra — 
 the aspect of the yetzer hara — the aspect of Esav. And therefore our Sages taught: 
 "At the time when the voice is the voice of Yaakov" — 
 when they engage in Torah — 
 "the hands are not the hands of Esav." 
 And our Sages expounded [Bava Kamma 82a]: 
 *"and they walked three days in the wilderness and found no water"* [Shemos 15:22] — 
 that they walked three days without Torah, and they arose and rebelled 
 [because the yetzer hara overpowered them] — 
 therefore the prophets and elders instituted 
 that they should read [the Torah] on Shabbos, Monday, and Thursday — etc. — 
 for when they engage in Torah, their yetzer is given into their hands — as our Sages taught.
 

 
 [§2]
 And therefore the primary reading of the Torah in its completeness is on Shabbos — 
 for "the Torah emanates from supernal Wisdom" [Zohar] — 
 and on Shabbos the light of Chochmah shines with a wondrous illumination, 
 and therefore it is called Kodesh [holy] — as is known — 
 and likewise Malchus ascends then with wondrous ascents — as is known. And therefore one also reads the Torah on Shabbos at Minchah — 
 to draw, through the holiness of Shabbos, the power of Torah reading 
 for the coming week as well. And one also reads the Torah on Monday and Thursday — 
 in order to subdue the kingdom of the sitra achra and the yetzer hara 
 also on the weekdays — 
 and all of this is only through the power of holy Torah study. And through this all prayers are accepted — 
 and therefore on Monday and Thursday one adds more prayers and supplications, 
 and recites V'Hu Rachum [He is compassionate].
 

 
 [§3]
 And therefore every Friday — 
 in which there is holiness and Torah in abundance — 
 and Kodesh is the aspect of Chochmah — as stated — 
 one multiplies the number of those called up [kruy'im] as our Sages taught. And they further said: 
 those three, five, and seven [called up] — corresponding to what? Corresponding to those who see the face of the King — etc. — 
 for through Torah reading one gives strength to the aspect of holy Malchus — as stated — 
 and Malchus is the aspect of Dalet — as stated — 
 and therefore one reads in the Torah four times each week. And therefore one does not read fewer than ten verses — 
 and our Sages said these correspond to the ten idlers of the synagogue 
 who are permanently stationed there to pray at the proper time each day with a congregation.
 

 
 [§4]
 And this is the aspect of prayer. And the synagogue too is the aspect of Malchus — as is known.

aligned_segments.he: כי המוחין הם עיקר החיים וע"כ כשנפטר אזי נוגע הדבר גם לרקרוביו.
aligned_segments.en:
And one [opinion] said: 
 [the ten verses] correspond to the Ten Commandments, which are the totality of the Torah. And one said: corresponding to the Ten Utterances [Asarah Ma'amaros] — 
 which are the life-force of every thing — 
 the aspect of wisdom and intellect clothed in every thing — 
 in the aspect of *"all of them You made with wisdom"* [Tehillim 104:24]. Except for the portion of Amalek — 
 which is the totality of the kingdoms of the sitra achra — 
 and in it is written: *"there is war for Hashem against Amalek from generation to generation"* [Shemos 17:16] — 
 for his [heavenly] prince is himself the yetzer hara — 
 and because of the power of free choice it is presently impossible to nullify him completely — 
 therefore his portion is also deficient, 
 containing only nine verses — as our Sages taught.

[§1] And therefore one may not set sail at sea, nor join a caravan fewer than three days before Shabbos — for three days before Shabbos the illumination of the coming Shabbos's holiness begins to shine — as is known — and they correspond to the aspects of Nefesh, Ruach, Neshamah — which are also the aspects of the three rectifications mentioned above — namely: the yoke of Heavenly Kingship, Torah, and Chochmah. And therefore one must prepare oneself from that time to receive the coming Shabbos's holiness in its fullness — and guard oneself from having any distress or confusion on Shabbos — and certainly not to come to any desecration of Shabbos, G-d forbid. But for a matter of mitzvah it is permitted even within the three days — for this is the ultimate purpose of all the rectifications — to fulfil His commandments — and one trusts in Hashem that He will save him from all distress and from any desecration of Shabbos.

סִימָן קל״ט וְכוּ׳ — הִלְכוֹת עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה

[§1]
The laws of idolatry. For the essential root of all idolatry is from the yetzer hara — which is itself the aspect of idolatry — as it is written: "there shall not be in you a strange god" [Tehillim 81:10] — and our Sages taught accordingly. And our Sages taught: "such is its way — today it says to him: do such — etc. — and tomorrow it says: go worship idolatry." And this is the essential impurity — the very opposite of holiness. For this is the essential sitra achra — and it is the aspect of vomit and excrement — for there is no aspect at all of the illumination of holy intellect in it — the aspect of: "My glory I shall not give to another" [Yeshayahu 42:8] — as explained elsewhere. And therefore they are called elilim [nothings] — for they are the aspect of absolute nothing — as if they never existed — the opposite of holy Chochmah — the aspect of yesh me'ayin [something from nothing] — as is known. And therefore idolatry is forbidden for any benefit — for all of a person's pleasure and his spirit's satisfaction is an aspect of a spark from the aspects of the portions of his life-force. But idolatry — which is the essential sitra d'mosa — it is forbidden for Israel to receive from it any benefit or any aspect of life-force whatsoever — for such a life-force is more bitter than death — G-d forbid.

[§2]
And this is the aspect of: it is forbidden for benefit — along with its accessories and its adornments and its offerings. Its accessories correspond to the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — for through serving before it — the aspect of a servant serving his master — one thereby shows that one is accepting the yoke of its kingdom. Its adornments correspond to the aspect of the intellect of the sitra achra — for the essential beauty and splendor at its root is from the aspect of Chochmah — the aspect of light — the aspect of: "a man's wisdom illuminates his face."

[§3]
And its offerings correspond to the aspect of the union of sun and moon of the sitra achra together — G-d forbid — and as they say: k'din metashteshei alma [it causes confusion in the world] — G-d forbid. For the sitra achra is like a monkey before a man.

aligned_segments.he: וע,כ אבל ביםו ראשון אסור בתפלין כמבואר שם.
aligned_segments.en:
And in holiness — the offering is in the aspect of the drawing close of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah — as understood in the holy Zohar. And: "the scattering of the wicked is good for them and good for the world" — for they are in the aspect of separation — as is known. And therefore their offering is a great damage — G-d forbid — for it indicates the connection and union — G-d forbid — between them.

[§4]
And therefore: idolatry of non-Jews is forbidden immediately — for they are from its aspect. But that of Israel is not forbidden until it is actually worshipped. For in truth — at the root of his holiness — he is utterly distant from it. But if one has already worshipped it — then on the contrary — since it is Israel's — it receives some additional power through this — since he is Israel whose root is in holiness. And therefore: idolatry of Israel has no nullification — but requires complete eradication and burning. But that of a non-Jew has nullification — for it has no such power — since all the nations themselves are as absolute nothing — as our Sages taught. And therefore: as soon as the non-Jew nullifies the idolatry — the prohibition departs from it. But its offerings have no nullification — for the power and aspect of the prohibition and the sitra achra has greatly cleaved there — because of the greatness of the damage of the aspect of the connection mentioned — for they are addicted to this most — as is known. And therefore: its accessories and adornments — even though nullification helps them — even so they are forbidden for use in a mitzvah — because they are repulsive.

[§5]
For in a mitzvah and holiness — there is the essential beauty and splendor of holiness. But the sitra achra — the aspect of idolatry and its accessories — even after they have been nullified — they are still repulsive to perform a matter of mitzvah and holiness with them.

[§6]
And therefore all benefits that come from it — etc. — are forbidden. And it is forbidden to listen to its singing — and to gaze upon its beauty — and to smell its scent. For all of this relates to the brain — in which is the source of all the senses of hearing and sight and smell.

aligned_segments.he: וע,כ מצוה לנחם את האבלים ולדבר על לבם שלא יצטערו יותר מדאי וכמ ושהזהיר גם הכתוב על זה ואמר בנים אתם לה' אלהיכם לא תתגודדו וכו' וארז"ל ע"ז כי פטירת אחד מישראל ר"ל הוא רק כמו האב ששלח אחר בנו לחזור ולשוב לבית אביו.
aligned_segments.en:
And therefore one thereby greatly damages the aspect of the holy brain and intellect. And therefore: if one does not intend — it is permitted — since it was done automatically without intention and knowledge — only when it is not the case that it is an inevitable consequence — etc. — as explained in the Shulchan Aruch.

[§7]
And therefore: a non-Jew can nullify idolatry — even if it is not his — and even if he hates it. But one who does not worship idolatry — such as a ger toshav [resident alien] or a Yishmaelite — cannot nullify it. For in truth the aspect of idolatry is already nullified from the outset — and of no importance — as stated — and all the more so: "for all the gods of the peoples are nothings." And the essential aspect of its power of suckling — which is for the sake of free choice — as is known — is only through this: that there are people who believe in it and worship it — and through this they infuse it with some aspect of suckling and power for the sake of free choice. And this is the aspect of what our Sages taught: "the gods of the nations are sustained by their worshippers." Meaning: those who worship it infuse them with some aspect of power.

[§8]
And this is the aspect of: "those who make them shall become like them — all who trust in them" [Tehillim 115:8] — for the idols themselves have no power or substance — as it is said: "they have a mouth and cannot speak" — etc. — only what appears to the worshippers as if there is some aspect of power and substance in them — is through this very act of worshipping and trusting in them — which is the essential making of them — in the aspect of: "those who make them — all who trust in them."

[§9]
And therefore: they themselves specifically can nullify it — but not one who does not worship them. And therefore: if it broke by itself — it is also forbidden until it is nullified. For what difference is there that it broke by itself — for it is broken and despised even from the outset — only the essential thing is that its worshippers themselves nullify it. And therefore: one who finds idolatry must eradicate and destroy it — and must uproot after it and give it a shameful name. For one must eradicate and nullify all types of hold of the sitra achra and the yetzer hara — which are the aspect of idolatry — until no root or branch remains to them at all — for: "today it says to do such" — etc. And one must give it a shameful name — for it itself is absolute nothing — only the essential of its power is through the name that its worshippers call it — and that they designate it with the name of a deity. And the matter of the name of every thing — is at its root a great matter — for a name alludes to the aspect of Chochmah and to the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of honor — as stated. And therefore important and respected people are called anshei shem [men of name]. And therefore one must give the name of idolatry a shameful designation — the opposite of the grace and honor mentioned. And therefore: it is forbidden to mention its name — and all the more so — not to swear by the name of idolatry.

aligned_segments.he: וכמ ושנחמה אשת ר' מאיר לר' מאיר על פטירת שני בניו כמו שארז"ל ודרכי ה' נעלמו מאתנו וא,א להבין דרכיו י)"ת ובודאי צדיק וישר הוא י"ת וכל דרכיו משפט ומנהיג עולמו בחסד וברחמים ומאד עמקו מחשבותיו י"ת.
aligned_segments.en:
And even not to cause a non-Jew to swear by the name of idolatry — as explained in the Shulchan Aruch.

[§1] And therefore it is forbidden to establish a feast and banquet on Erev Shabbos — unless it is an obligatory [mitzvah] meal at its proper time — etc. — And people of exemplary conduct fast every Erev Shabbos — for it has already been explained that the essential completeness of holy eating is on Shabbos — for then Esav — the sitra achra — has no hold in the eating and the meal. And therefore one must prepare oneself for this — to be eager to eat on Shabbos — and to defer and prevent oneself from a weekday meal in honor of the Shabbos meal — and thereby to subdue the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — the yetzer hara — the dominion of Esav — [whose hold is in weekday eating] — before the Shabbos meal when holy Malchus ascends in its fullness. For Yaakov is the first of whom it is written that he kept Shabbos — as our Sages taught.

סִימָן קמ״ח וְכוּ׳

[§1]
And therefore: it is forbidden to trade with them on the day of their festivals — etc. — and likewise several other laws explained in these simanim and those that follow — all in order that we have no share in their joy and their worship — and not to give them any power or any hold whatsoever. And this is the aspect of the prohibition of lo sechanem [do not show them favor].

[§2]
Techanem specifically — so as not to draw upon them the aspect of chen [grace] — the aspect of ches and nun — as stated. For they are the very opposite of holy chen. And see in tractate Avodah Zarah [20a] — where our Sages taught three interpretations: lo sechanem — do not give them a dwelling place on the land. Alternatively: lo sechanem — do not grant them grace. Alternatively: lo sechanem — do not give them gifts freely. And see the Shulchan Aruch, Siman 151. And everything revolves around the matter stated above. Nachas HaShulchan — Part VII (Yoreh Deah) · Segment 3 · Simanim 87–178

נַחַת הַשֻּׁלְחָן

Nachas HaShulchan — Part VII
Yoreh Deah · Segment 4 · Simanim 157–335

Pikuach Nefesh · Ribbis · Garments · Sorcery · Niddah · Mikvaos · Vows · Kibbud Av · Torah Study · Tzedakah · Milah · Gerim · Torah Scroll · Mezuzah · Kilayim · Bikur Cholim · Conclusion of Yoreh Deah

By Rabbi Nachman of Tchehrin ז״ל

[§1] One should rise early in the morning on Friday to prepare for Shabbos' needs — for our Sages taught: "One who labored before Shabbos will eat on Shabbos" — etc. — for Shabbos is the aspect of the World to Come — for then one will merit to receive from the light of supernal holy Chochmah in its fullness — which is the essential life of the World to Come — in the aspect of "the righteous sit and benefit from the radiance of the Shechinah" — that they will merit to attain His G-dliness in full attainment — through the aspect of Malchus.

סִימָן קנ״ה — הִלְכוֹת בֵּית הַכְּנֶסֶת

 

 
 [§1]
 It is already explained that the synagogue is a place of prayer 
 and corresponds to the aspect of Malchus — as stated — 
 and therefore it must be the tallest of all the buildings of the city. For the aspect of Malchus is the aspect of height, elevation, and exaltedness — 
 as is written concerning Shaul: 
 *"and he was taller than all the people from his shoulders upward"* [Shemuel I 9:2] — 
 and Shemuel said about this: 
 "Do you see that Hashem has chosen him, that there is none like him among all the people?" — 
 and concerning the Messianic King it is said: 
 *"he shall be exalted and lifted up and very high"* [Yeshayahu 52:13]. And also because in every house there is the aspect of Malchus — 
 in the aspect of "every man shall rule in his own house" [Esther 1:22] — 
 and our Sages expounded: "He made them houses — houses of royalty." 
 And therefore the synagogue — which alludes to holy Malchus — 
 must be the tallest and most elevated of all.
 

 
 [§2]
 And therefore one compels one another to build a synagogue 
 and to purchase Torah scrolls, Talmud, and so on — 
 for the essential power of holy Malchus is through the holy Torah — as stated. And therefore it is permitted to convert a synagogue into a house of study [beis midrash] — 
 as explained in Siman 153 — 
 for in the beis midrash one engages in Torah, 
 through which one gives strength to holy Malchus — 
 and therefore its sanctity exceeds that of the synagogue.

aligned_segments.he: ועי"ז שמנחמים אות ובכדי שלא יתגבר עליו העצבות שהיא בעצמה בחי' סטרא דמוץתא ביותר ע,כ עי"ז ממשיכןי ומעוררין בחי' אור החים ובפרט כי הבאים לבית האבל נתעוררין בתשובה להתחיל להשתדל לחיות חיים אמיתיים כמאמר הכתוב טוב ללכת אל בי תהאבל וכו' והחי יתן אל לבו ע,כ הוא נייח נפש גם להנפטר מאחר שע"י מיתתו דייקא זכו להתעורר לאור החיים כי באמת גם לגבי עצמו של נפש הנפטר עיקר מיתתו הוא בכדי שתזכה נשמתו לעלות ולכנוס בפרגודא דמלכא ששם עיקר אור החיםי בבחי' באור פני מלך חיים.ו זה ג"כ נמשך ע"י ז' ימי אבלות כמובן במאמר עתיקא סי' כ"א וזה בחי' מה שאומרים קדיש אחר נפש הנפטר והוא תועלת גדול לנשמתו כי מאחר שנשאר ממנו שארית בארץ שמקדישין שמו ית' ברבים שבשביל זה נ ברא הכל וזהו התכלית של כל בחי' החכמה והחיות ע,כ נחשב כאלו הוא עצמו חי גם בעוה"ז בפרט שזוכה עי"ז ליאור באור החיים האמיתים של עולם העליון הק'.
aligned_segments.en:
And therefore after leaving the synagogue one must immediately go to the beis midrash 
 and establish a fixed time for learning — as explained in Siman 155. And therefore our Sages taught: 
 "Whoever goes from the synagogue to the beis midrash" — etc. — 
 "merits and receives the face of the Shechinah" — etc. — 
 meaning he merits to bind himself to and see, with an open eye, 
 even in this world, the light of the intellect and wisdom 
 and divine life-force clothed in every thing — 
 which is also the aspect of receiving the face of the Shechinah — as stated. And through this he naturally merits in the World to Come 
 to receive the face of the Shechinah literally — as it were.

סִימָן קנה — הִלְכוֹת מִיאוּן

[§1]
A minor girl who has no father can depart from her husband through mi'un [refusal]. For complete kiddushin — which flow from the aspect of these rectifications — and essentially from the aspect of Chochmah — called holiness. And even if she herself was still a minor — but her father received her kiddushin — and the Torah granted him this right — therefore she cannot depart from her husband except with a get. For it is impossible to sever the connection between them — except also according to these rectifications — essentially according to holy Torah — which encompasses all these rectifications. The aspect of: "the document severs her" — and nothing else severs her — as stated. But if she was married as a minor — and not with the knowledge of her father — her kiddushin are not complete kiddushin — since she is not yet in the aspect of knowledge and wisdom. Therefore she does not require a get — but departs through mi'un alone.

[§2] But not all will be equal then — and "every Tzaddik is burned by the canopy of his fellow" [Bava Basra 75a] — as our Sages taught — for everything is according to the abundance of one's deeds. And the more a person strives in this — even in this world, to accept upon himself the complete yoke of Heavenly Kingship and to bind himself and look only at the wisdom and intellect and divine life-force in every thing — the more he merits this in the World to Come — in the aspect of: "one who labored on the eve of Shabbos will eat on Shabbos."

סִימָן קנ״ו — סֵדֶר מַשָּׂא וּמַתָּן

 
 [§1]
 "Afterwards he shall go to his affairs" — etc. For it has already been explained that it is not sufficient to merely give strength 
 to holy Malchus to overpower the kingdom of the sitra achra — 
 one must also clarify and elevate the holy sparks 
 from within the sitra achra and the klippos — 
 in the secret of the eleven spices of the Ketores [incense] — 
 and this is accomplished through commerce conducted in faithfulness — 
 as understood in the discourse Ashray Zarka, Siman 35, 
 and the discourse Ki Seitzei, Siman 280. And this too is accomplished only through the power of holy Torah study — as explained there. And therefore one should make one's livelihood incidental and one's Torah primary.
 

 
 [§2]
 And therefore one must be careful not to form a partnership with non-Jews — etc. — 
 due to [the prohibition]: "and the name of other gods shall not be heard on your lips" [Shemos 23:13] — 
 for since the essential purpose of commerce is to elevate the holy sparks from them, 
 how can one form a partnership with him in this?

aligned_segments.he: ועכ"פ מקילין מעליו עונש הגיהנם כמובא בזוה"ק.
aligned_segments.en:
And particularly if the non-Jew might invoke the name of idolatry — 
 one would thereby on the contrary give yet more power, G-d forbid, 
 to the kingdom of the sitra achra — the aspect of other gods. See there in the gloss which is lenient regarding this in our times — etc. But to buy and sell with them without partnership is universally permitted — etc. — 
 for this is the essential intent of commerce: 
 to elevate the holy sparks from them, 
 and to extract what they have swallowed — 
 in the aspect of *"He has swallowed wealth and will vomit it"* [Iyov 20:15].
 

 
 
 
 סִימָן קנ״ז–קנ״ח — הִלְכוֹת נְטִילַת יָדַיִם לַסְּעוּדָה

[§1]
 And therefore one must wash one's hands for the meal — 
 for there is reason to suspect, since the hands are busy [and may have touched something impure], 
 and then when one eats with them the bread — 
 which is the aspect of Malchus, its root also being in Chochmah — as is known — 
 as is explained in the intentions of eating, 
 for the table and the bread are the aspect of Malchus — 
 and the essential rectification of eating is through the aspect of Chochmah — 
 through what is chewed with the teeth, which are 32 in number, 
 corresponding to the 32 paths of Chochmah — etc. — see there. And therefore the essential life of a person is through eating — 
 for inwardly the illumination of the holy Chochmah is drawn through it — 
 as it is said of Chochmah: *"and wisdom gives life"* [Koheles 7:12]. And since this is so — and the opposite is also true — 
 there is reason to suspect: 
 if one's hands are impure, 
 the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — 
 the yetzer hara — the klippa of Esav — 
 which is the essential impurity — 
 may thereby attach itself to one's eating. For it is said of [Esav]: 
 *"and Esav despised the birthright"* [Bereishis 25:34] — 
 meaning he despised the holy wisdom and intellect — as is explained within — 
 and this came through the desire for eating — 
 as he said: "feed me now" [ibid. 25:30] — etc. — 
 and through this he sold the birthright and despised it. And the essential hold and strengthening [of Esav] is through the aspect of the impure hands — 
 in the aspect of *"but the hands are the hands of Esav"* [Bereishis 27:22] — as stated.
 

 
 [§2]
 And therefore one must wash the hands with water — 
 which alludes to Torah — as stated — 
 and also to holy Chochmah — as it is written: 
 *"for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of Hashem as waters cover the sea"* [Yeshayahu 11:9]. And through this one lifts the hands on high and binds them 
 to the aspect of Chochmah — which is the aspect of Kodesh [holy] — 
 and to the holy Torah — 
 in the aspect of *"lift your hands in holiness"* [Tehillim 134:2] — 
 and *"and I will lift my palms toward Your commandments"* [Tehillim 119:48] — 
 the aspect of the holy Torah.
 

 
 [§3]
 And therefore our Sages taught [Chullin 106a]: 
 "first waters caused [the eating of] pig's meat" — 
 for if one does not wash the first waters [before eating], 
 the yetzer hara can overpower him and defile his eating 
 to the degree that he comes to eat actual forbidden foods, G-d forbid — 
 the aspect of pig's meat specifically — 
 for this is the aspect of the klippa of Esav, 
 who is called chazir hayaar [the pig of the forest]. And also because the pig is the aspect of the wisdom of the klippa — 
 as explained in the Maurai Or — 
 meaning: not only does he not bind himself to holy Chochmah — 
 he also becomes attached to the wisdom of the klippa — 
 and through this stumbles in the external wisdoms of heresy and outright denial, G-d forbid.
 

 
 [§4]
 And the other opinion said: 
 "first waters caused [the eating of] neveilah [carcass]" — 
 meaning one becomes separated through this from the aspect of holy Malchus — 
 the aspect of the moon — 
 and becomes attached to the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — 
 the moon of the sitra achra — 
 which is the aspect of neveilah — 
 in the aspect of "naval" [boor] — 
 who despises the holy intellect and becomes a naval [degraded one] alongside him — see the Maurai Or. And therefore one who is contemptuous of netilas yadayim 
 comes to poverty — 
 corresponding to his having damaged the aspect of holy Malchus — 
 the aspect of misken v'chacham [poor and wise] — 
 and is uprooted from the world — 
 corresponding to his having damaged and separated himself 
 from the holy Chochmah, 
 which is the essential sustenance and life of the world — 
 in the aspect of *"and wisdom gives life"* [Koheles 7:12] — as stated.

[§5]
 And therefore one washes the hands only in a vessel — 
 which alludes to the aspect of Malchus — 
 the aspect of contraction — the aspect of a vessel — as is known. And the vessel must hold a revi'is [quarter-log] — 
 which also alludes to the aspect of Malchus — as is known — 
 and not while resting [on a surface that holds it, if the vessel cannot stand on its own] — 
 for our Sages taught, cited above: 
 why is the letter nun not stated in Tehillah l'Dovid [Psalm 145]? Because it refers to a downfall of the Community of Israel [which is the aspect of nun] — 
 as is said: *"the maiden of Israel has fallen and shall rise no more"* [Amos 5:2] — 
 and yet Dovid returned and supported her by the holy spirit — 
 as it is said: *"Hashem supports all who fall"* [Tehillim 145:14]. It follows that a vessel which cannot stand on its own and falls — 
 and therefore only holds a revi'is when supported — 
 alludes to the aspect of Malchus in the time of its falling, when it needs support. But during the time of washing the hands, one should not allude to this — 
 only to the aspect of the complete holy Malchus at the time of its ascent to Kodesh — 
 which is the aspect of Chochmah — as stated.
 

 
 [§6]
 And therefore the measure of water is a revi'is — 
 alluding to the aspect of Malchus — 
 the aspect of Dalet — the aspect of misken v'chacham — as stated.

aligned_segments.he: כי עי"ז ניצל מדינא של גיהנם שהוא מצד בחינת עשו כנ"ל.
aligned_segments.en:
Nonetheless one should add generously when washing — 
 and thereby merits wealth — 
 for through receiving from the aspect of Chochmah, 
 wealth flows — in the aspect of 
 *"in the shadow of wisdom, in the shadow of silver"* [Koheles 7:12] — as our Sages taught — 
 see the discourse LaShemesh Sham, Siman 49.
 

 
 [§7]
 And since the essential hand-washing for the meal is to prevent the sitra achra 
 from attaching to the eating — as stated — 
 the obligation falls only upon the one who eats, not upon the one who serves — 
 as explained in Siman 163.

[§8]
 The waters must come specifically through human force — 
 for human force alludes to Chochmah — 
 since Chochmah contains the letters כֹּחַ מַ״ה — 
 [koach mah — "the power of mah"] — 
 and mah in numerical value equals Adam [man] — as is cited. And therefore one must intend for the washing that is fit for eating — 
 for intention, which is thought, is the aspect of Chochmah / the brain — 
 as cited in the holy Tikkunnim. And therefore one who immersed his hands in spring water 
 is purified with any quantity — 
 for a spring alludes to Chochmah — as is known.
 

 
 [§9]
 Water in which work was done is invalid — 
 for it has already been explained that work [melachah] is performed 
 in order to clarify and elevate the holy sparks 
 clothed within the klippa — the kingdom of the sitra achra — 
 and therefore since work was done with these [waters] 
 and the sitra achra had a hold upon them, 
 one cannot thereby purify the hands for the meal.

סִימָן קנו וְכוּ׳ — הִלְכוֹת יִבּוּם וְחֲלִיצָה

[§1]
The laws of yibum [levirate marriage] and chalitzah [release]. It is already explained: that a person must leave children after oneself — who will engage in this — to bind themselves to the intellect in every thing — to recognize the Creator through every thing. And this is the purpose of Creation. And through this one is considered as if one is alive in the world. And as our Sages truly taught: "all who leave a son engaging in Torah — it is as if one never died." "Engaging in Torah" specifically — for through Torah study — through this is the essential drawing of these rectifications — the essential aspect of life. Only: this is in their free choice — whether to engage in Torah. But in any case the obligation is upon one to leave children. And therefore: one who died and left no children — one's death is the aspect of the sitra d'mosa literally — G-d forbid. Since there remains no remnant on earth who will engage in drawing these rectifications. Until because of this — our Sages taught about one who has no children — that one is considered as dead even in one's lifetime — and all the more so after actual death — G-d forbid. And therefore: holy Torah found a remedy for one — through the brother from the father — who both drew from one root and one father. Who at his root alludes to the aspect of Chochmah — the aspect of: "father in wisdom." And therefore: when the brother marries the wife of the dead — in whom some impression remains of the illumination of Chochmah that her first husband — who died — bestowed upon her.

aligned_segments.he: וזה יתגדל ויתקדש וכו' היינו בחי' גדלות המוחין והחכמה שהוא בחי' קודש והוא מקור החסד שנקרא גדולה כידוע.
aligned_segments.en:
The aspect of: "that spirit which the husband left in her." And therefore: through this — the soul of the departed will be reincarnated in the son born from this union — and will return to engage in drawing these rectifications — meaning: to draw the holy intellect and wisdom in the world. The aspect of the birthright — as stated. And this is what the verse says: *"and the firstborn which she bears shall succeed in the name of his dead brother — and his name shall not be erased from Israel"* [Devarim 25:6]. "The firstborn" specifically — the aspect of the birthright mentioned — for only for this was the yibum done — in order to restore and draw the soul of the departed — so that it engage in drawing holy intellect — the aspect of the birthright — for the sake of which Yaakov took the birthright from Esav. And all the children of Israel are called firstborns — as the verse says: "my firstborn son — Israel" [Shemos 4:22]. And therefore this son born from the commandment of yibum — the aspect of a firstborn — therefore he shall succeed in the name of his dead brother. For he will engage in drawing these rectifications — the aspect of shem [name] — as stated. And this: "and his name shall not be erased from Israel." His name specifically — as stated. And our Sages expounded: "and the firstborn" — etc. — this refers to the yavam [brother] — for it is a mitzvah for the eldest brother to do the yibum. And he receives the inheritance of the dead in his father's estate. And this too is because of the above — for since he engages in restoring the soul of the dead in the world — and elevating it from the aspect of the sitra d'mosa to the light of Chochmah and life — the aspect of the birthright — therefore the yavam is called the firstborn — and receives the inheritance of the dead. For through him: one's dead brother too is considered as living. And therefore he receives the inheritance. (And see the Shulchan Aruch, Siman 163.)

[§2]
And if he does not wish to do the yibum — she requires chalitzah. And this: "and she shall remove his shoe from upon his foot — and spit before his face" [Devarim 25:9] — etc. — and it is elaborated in Zohar Chadash and likewise in the Shulchan Aruch: that this is done as a disgrace to him — to lead him in shame [u'l'anhiga beih kalna].

aligned_segments.he: וזה וימליך מלכותיה בחי' מלכות הנ"ל וזה בחיכון וכו' כי משם עיקר החיים כנ,ל.
aligned_segments.en:
For since he did not wish to do the yibum — and restore the soul of the dead in the world — so that it engage in drawing holy intellect and wisdom in the world — through which His honor is revealed. Until through this even the yavam himself merits honor — the aspect of: "the wise shall inherit honor" — and the aspect of: "those who honor Me — I will honor." And since the yavam does not wish to engage in this — therefore he deserves disgrace and shame. The aspect of: "the fool raises shame." And this is also a benefit for the departed soul and for the yevamah. For initially the soul of the departed was attached after the brother — for it was hoping that he would return and rebuild through it. And because of this — the aspect of: "the spirit the husband left in her" — did not want to depart and be released from her — for she was waiting for her rectification through this. And therefore the Torah said: "the wife of the dead shall not be outside" [Devarim 25:5] — etc. But now — when he stands before the court and says explicitly: "I do not wish to take her" — it is understood from this that she found no favor in his eyes — and their union will not be in the aspect of holy union in its fullness. Therefore holy Torah found another remedy for her through chalitzah. For holy intellect clothed in all the matters of this world is in the aspect of the holy feet — the aspect of: "and the earth is the footstool of My feet" [Yeshayahu 66:1]. (See the discourse Mikreh Zikaron, Siman 54.) And the yetzer hara and the sitra achra — whose essential dominion is in this world — the essential hold of theirs is only in the aspect of the holy feet — as it were — the aspect of: "and you shall bruise his heel" [Bereishis 3:15] — the aspect of: "her feet descend to death." And the aspect of: "the iniquity of my heels surrounds me" [Tehillim 49:6]. And therefore Yaakov our father — who merited the aspect of holy intellect — was called Yaakov. For he merited to bind all the matters of this world — which are in the aspect of feet — the aspect of akev [heel] — to the intellect and wisdom. The aspect of the Yud of Yaakov. (And see in the Tikkunim, Tikkun 26 — where it is also understood that the secret of chalitzah is in the secret of how Yaakov our father took the birthright — etc. — see there.)

[§3]
And since their essential hold is in the aspect of feet and heel — therefore one needs extra vigilance and guarding there.

aligned_segments.he: וזה ואמרו אמן בחי' חיבור התקונים הנ"ל כידוע.
aligned_segments.en:
The aspect of what our Sages taught: "let a person always sell — etc. — and buy shoes for his feet." And the woman is also in the aspect of feet — the aspect of: "the feet of His pious ones — He guards — this is the woman" [Shmuel I 2:9]. And our Sages taught: she makes her husband stand on his feet. And likewise she is called a shoe — as cited in the Tikkunim: "your shoe — etc. — this is the woman." And therefore: the soul of this departed one without children — G-d forbid — is attached after his wife — because of that spirit that the husband left in her. And likewise attached at the heel of the brother — as our Sages taught — for he is hoping to be rectified through them — through their restoring his soul in this world. The aspect of feet. And illuminating in him the aspects of Metatron and Sandalfon — which are in the aspect of shoe and sandal — in which the holy feet of the Most High are clothed — as it were. As elaborated in the holy Zohar and the Tikkunim. And therefore: when the yavam does not wish to do the yibum — she must remove his shoe from upon his foot — and strike it on the ground.

[§4]
To show that the soul of the departed should not expect to be rectified through the brother — but Hashem Himself will find a complete rectification for it through His great mercy and kindness. And this: "and she spits before his face" — and through this the spirit that the husband left in her departs. And this: "before his face" specifically — for: "the wisdom of a man illuminates his face." And through this one merits honor — the aspect of: "the wise shall inherit honor" — as stated. And now — when she disgraces and shames him — by spitting in his face — through this it is seen and evident that he has not merited the aspect of holy wisdom that would illuminate his face. Only the reverse. And through this the soul of the departed is released and separated from them — for it sees there is nothing for it to expect for the rectification of its soul through them — through the aspect of drawing these rectifications — the aspects of supernal Chochmah — the aspect of the light of the face — and Malchus — the aspect of the last level — the aspect of sof davar — the aspect of feet. And therefore: through removing the shoe from his foot and spitting in his face — it is revealed that he has nothing to expect from them — and it will be rectified through Hashem's kindness in a manner good and fitting for it.

aligned_segments.he: וזה יהא שמיה רבה מברך וכו' כי כל בחי' התיקונים הנ"ל כולם כלולים בבחי' אותיות שמ וית' כידוע.
aligned_segments.en: And therefore: in our times — even if both desire the yibum — one does not allow them to do the yibum — unless it is evident and known that their intention is for the sake of the mitzvah. For the essential rectification of the soul of the departed through the yibum — that it return and come to this world — in order to engage in drawing these rectifications — depends only on the intention of the yavam. As elaborated in the holy Zohar on the verse: *"if he sets his heart toward Him — his spirit and his soul He will gather"* [Iyov 34:14]. But if their intention is not for the sake of the mitzvah — only for the sake of desire — the aspect of the yetzer hara — the sitra d'mosa — G-d forbid — how can the soul of the departed be rectified through this — and ascend from the sitra d'mosa to the light of life? And if so: the yavam transgresses the prohibition of forbidden relations — G-d forbid. And therefore it is better to perform chalitzah. And therefore: one performs chalitzah with the right foot — for the soul of the departed — who is attached at the heel of the brother — for the sake of its rectification — the essential thing is in the aspect of the right foot — the aspect of: "the heart of the wise is to his right." For this is the essential will and intention of the soul of the departed — as stated. And therefore: the commandment of chalitzah requires three Israelite judges — corresponding to the three Patriarchs — the aspects of the totality of these rectifications. And one adds two more — for publicity's sake. The aspect of holiness — the aspect of: "not from the beginning in secret did I speak" — as elaborated above in the laws of kiddushin. And likewise here — in the matter of chalitzah — which appears to be against the Torah that obligated him to do the yibum — the aspect of the disgrace and shame the yavam has. For the sake of this — through the chalitzah — as elaborated in the Shulchan Aruch — therefore they publicize the matter — to know that this too is not from the sitra achra — G-d forbid — whose way is to come in stealth and secrecy. But this matter of chalitzah is done in public and openly — since everything is done according to the commandment of holy Torah. And even though it is explained above that the disgrace of the chalitzah is in the aspect of: "the fool raises shame" — even so: since in our times the commandment of chalitzah takes precedence — for the reason mentioned — lest one come to transgress forbidden relations — G-d forbid.

aligned_segments.he: וגם כי ארז"ל מה שמו דא חכמה וכן שם הוא בחי' מלכות והתורה ג"כ היא שמא דקוב"ה.
aligned_segments.en:
Therefore this too is in the category of what our Sages taught: "better to be called a fool — etc. — and not be wicked for even one hour before the Omnipresent." And therefore both must intend that through this chalitzah she shall be permitted to a stranger. For even the rectification of chalitzah depends only on the intention of the heart — whose root is in Chochmah — as stated.

[§5]
And therefore: a minor girl who performed chalitzah — her chalitzah is invalid. And likewise if he is deaf-mute — mentally incompetent — or a minor — since they lack understanding. And this is the aspect of the three things in chalitzah — which are: the removal of the shoe — the spitting — and the calling. And they correspond to the three rectifications mentioned. The removal of the shoe corresponds to the aspect of Malchus — as stated. The spitting before his face corresponds to the aspect of Chochmah. The calling corresponds to the aspect of Torah study — the aspect of calling. And there is still more to elaborate on this — according to the above — as is self-evident.

[§3] And therefore one must hasten to engage in this from one's very youth — for *"precious is one hour of repentance and good deeds in this world"* [Avos 4:17] — etc. — and there is no loss like the loss of time — for it has already been explained that in every moment and time is clothed a new wisdom of how to recognize Him and draw close to Him through it. And therefore even regarding the practical preparation of Shabbos — one must also rise early on Friday morning.

סִימָן קנ״ז

[§1]
For all transgressions in the Torah one should transgress rather than be killed — etc. For the soul of Israel and their holy life-force flows from the source of supernal Chochmah — from which is the root of all Torah.

[§2]
And therefore: saving a single life of Israel overrides Shabbos — and likewise all commandments. But if the non-Jew intends to cause him to transgress the religion — then if he is in the presence of ten Jews — if he listens to the non-Jew there is a desecration of G-d's Name — and one thereby damages automatically in the root of his life-force — for all that the Holy One created He created only for His honor. And honor is the aspect of Chochmah — as is known.

aligned_segments.he: וע"כ מתפללין ע"ז שיהיו נחשכין כל התקונים הנ"ל בשלימות ויהיה שמו הגדול מבורך וכו'לעילא מן כל ברכתא וכו' דאמירן בעלמא.
aligned_segments.en:
And therefore even over a shoelace strap — (which is the custom of Israel — so that there be a distinction between them and non-Jews) — one should be killed rather than transgress. And likewise for idolatry and sexual immorality and bloodshed — even in private — and the non-Jew intends only for his own pleasure — one should be killed rather than transgress. For regarding bloodshed: it is a logical argument — "what do you see?" — etc. — "perhaps your fellow's blood is redder" — for perhaps his fellow's life-force flows from an even higher aspect. And likewise: through idolatry — G-d forbid — one certainly damages all the roots of one's life-force — for it is as if one denies the entire Torah. And likewise: the damage of sexual immorality is very great — and damages all one's life-force — and it is as if one damaged the entire Torah — and it causes the aspect of separation — G-d forbid — in the holy union — and gives power and life-force to the sitra achra — G-d forbid. And therefore one should be killed rather than transgress — and through this a great rectification is made above — as is known. And through this many holy sparks are elevated — and the aspect of holy life-force clothed in the sitra d'mosa as well. And then all evildoers shall be scattered — and death shall be swallowed forever — and all the horns of the wicked shall be cut off — the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.

[§4] And therefore one must repent every Erev Shabbos — to rectify through one's repentance whatever one may have damaged in the days of the week — through following one's yetzer — the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — which is the opposite of the holiness of Shabbos.

סִימָן קנ״ח

[§1]
And therefore it is forbidden to heal a non-Jew or save him from death — since they are inherently in the aspect of the sitra d'mosa. But even so — there is no commandment to kill them — for presumably they too have some use in the world for the sake of maintaining free choice. But heretics and apostates and informers — and those who transgress to spite — it is a commandment to bring about their death. For since they have uprooted themselves from the holiness of Israel — who are bound to the source of holy life — and have descended in their wickedness to the ultimate lowness of the level of the sitra d'mosa — it is therefore a commandment to eradicate them from the world — so that the aspect of the sitra d'mosa not grow stronger in the world — G-d forbid.

[§2]
And therefore: one who transgresses only out of appetite — because one cannot overpower one's inclination — one must not stand on his blood — and it is a commandment to save him. For he is still bound to the holiness of Israel — and to the aspect of holy life — only he cannot overpower his inclination and conquer his free choice. And certainly he will receive his punishment. But even so — even at the time of transgression — he has distress from having come to such a state — and he knows that it will be bitter in the end.

aligned_segments.he: כי אנו יודעים שכל בחי' המשכת התיקונים הנ"ל שממשיכין בעולם אפילו הגדולים שבגדולים אין לזה ערך כלל כנגד גדולתו י"ת כי הוא י"ת מתרומם על כל ברכה ותהלה ובאמת זה בעצמו תכלית שלימות השגת החכמה דקדושה לידע שרחוק ממנו החכמה שזה בחי' תכלית הידיעה אשר לא נדעך וכמובא בדבריו ז"ל בכמה מקומות.
aligned_segments.en:
And perhaps he will yet merit true regret and complete repentance. And this is according to: *"for whoever is joined to all the living — there is hope"* [Koheles 9:4] — and Rashi explains: even if he is wicked and joins with the wicked — etc. — there is hope that he may repent before his death.

[§3]
This is as stated. And through this the entire matter of the verse is explained there: *"for a living dog is better than a dead lion"* [Koheles 9:4] — "for the living know they will die — but the dead know nothing." That is: as long as one has not uprooted oneself from the life of holiness entirely — even though one cannot overpower one's inclination — even so: one had distress from this — for one knows one is destined for death — and to give account for everything. And therefore one is in the aspect of the living dog — who is at a very low and humble level — as is evident from our Sages' teaching: what is it to castrate a dog? — and even so it is better than the dead lion. Meaning: better than one who uproots oneself from the life of holiness entirely — a heretic or habitual sinner — who although alive and strengthening and succeeding greatly — even so is in the aspect of the dead lion. And it is a commandment to eradicate him from the world so that he not cause the land to fester. But if one transgresses only out of appetite — not to spite — and knows one will die and fears it — then one is still in the category of joining with all the living — and there is hope and trust that one will repent. And it is a commandment to save and sustain such a person — as stated.

[§5] And therefore one should remove cobwebs from the house on Erev Shabbos — for they are from the aspect of the sitra achra — the kingdom of Esav — as our Sages expounded on the verse *"a spider grasps with its hands"* [Mishlei 30:28].

סִימָן קנ״ט וְכוּ׳ — הִלְכוֹת רִבִּית

[§1]
The matter of the prohibition of ribbis [usury]. For through lending to a poor person — or even to a rich person when he needs to borrow — which is itself the aspect of poverty — all of this flows at its root from the aspect of the poverty of holy Malchus — which is in the aspect of the poor wise man — as stated. And through arousal from below — arousal comes from above. And therefore: through charity and acts of loving-kindness — through this the illumination of the aspect of supernal Chochmah (whose root is the aspect of wealth — as our Sages taught: "once he grew wise — he grew rich" — etc.) is drawn and shines upon holy Malchus. And then it rises from the aspect of poverty — and the moonlight becomes as the sunlight — the aspect of chen — as stated. And therefore such a loan is called in rabbinic language: a loan of grace [halva'as chen] — and likewise in the language of Scripture: *"a good man shows grace and lends"* [Tehillim 112:5].

[§2]
And this: *"and if your brother becomes poor"* [Vayikra 25:25] — *"and you shall hold him"* — *"and he shall live with you"* — and the essential life-force is from the aspect of: "wisdom gives life" — etc. — as stated. And this: "do not take from him interest and increase" — for through this on the contrary — he draws and suckles the lifeblood — the very essence of his blood.

[§3]
And his poverty grows even more through this.

aligned_segments.he: וע"כ הקדיש הוא טובה לנפש הנפטר אפילו אם הוא אדם גדול כמובא.
aligned_segments.en:
And this: "you shall fear your G-d" — the aspect of the awe of Malchus. And: "your brother shall live with you" — the aspect of: "wisdom gives life." And this: the verse concludes: "I am Hashem your G-d" — our Sages taught: through this mitzvah one accepts upon oneself the yoke of Heavenly Kingship — or conversely — G-d forbid — as stated. And this is what our Sages taught: one who lends with interest — it is as if he denies the resurrection of the dead.

[§4]
Whose root is from the aspect of: "wisdom gives life." And the Exodus from Egypt.

[§5]
Which is the aspect of the ascent of Malchus — as is known. And this: "from the foreigner you may take interest" — for through this one extracts from him the sparks of the aspect of holy life-force that fell there. But: "but from your brother you shall not take interest." And therefore: one who lends with interest — it is as if he denies the G-d of Israel — as our Sages taught.

[§6]
Since one thereby damages the aspects of the rectifications that the person of Israel must bind himself to — in order to draw close to Him — and to know and recognize Him — through this — as stated. And therefore: even early and late ribbis are forbidden — for through ribbis one damages the aspects of Chochmah and Malchus — which are the aspects of achor [back] and kadem [front] — as is known.

[§7]
And therefore also ribbis of words is forbidden — for speech also encompasses both these aspects. And this is what our Sages taught [Bava Metzia 61]: they equated lenders with interest to shedders of blood — for not only does he not draw life-force to the borrower — in the aspect of: "and your brother shall live with you" — but on the contrary: he sucks from him the very essence of his life-force through the interest. And this is what our Sages taught [there, 71]: "come and see the blindness of the eyes of lenders with interest." Blindness of eyes — specifically — the opposite of what one must gaze with an open eye upon holy intellect and wisdom. And this: "one who calls his fellow wicked descends to his very life" — for wicked is from the sitra d'mosa — the opposite of the holy life-force. And this: "he brings witnesses" — etc. — "and writes and signs: so-and-so has denied the G-d of Israel" — as stated. And this is what our Sages taught [there, 75]: "not only that — but they make Moshe our teacher a sage and his Torah truth" — etc. — meaning: they damage the aspect of Moshe — who is the aspect of the sun — the aspect of holy daas and Chochmah — and damage the aspect of Torah — through which strength is given to holy Malchus — until the moonlight becomes as the sunlight — as stated.
